affogato.zh: 手将两只空玻璃甜品杯放进冰箱冷藏。
affogato.en: A hand places two empty glass dessert cups in the refrigerator to chill.

affogato.zh: 手用冰淇淋勺将紧实的香草冰淇淋球装入杯中。
affogato.en: A hand uses an ice cream scoop to place a firm ball of vanilla ice cream into a cup.

affogato.zh: 咖啡机正将浓缩咖啡萃取到两只小杯中。
affogato.en: An espresso machine extracts coffee into two small cups.

affogato.zh: 手将浓缩咖啡浇在冰淇淋球上，杯底形成奶咖。
affogato.en: A hand pours espresso over the ice cream, forming milky coffee at the bottom.

affogato.zh: 手用小勺舀起冰淇淋和外层咖啡。
affogato.en: A hand scoops up ice cream and the surrounding coffee with a small spoon.

agedashi-dofu.zh: 手将轻盘放在裹着湿纸的整块豆腐上。
agedashi-dofu.en: Hands set a light plate on a block of tofu wrapped in damp paper.

agedashi-dofu.zh: 双手轻挤萝卜泥，旁边放着葱花和姜泥。
agedashi-dofu.en: Hands gently squeeze grated daikon beside scallion rings and grated ginger.

agedashi-dofu.zh: 手搅拌小锅里的浇汁，锅边冒着小泡。
agedashi-dofu.en: A hand stirs sauce in a small pan as tiny bubbles gather at the edges.

agedashi-dofu.zh: 手用厨房纸轻按豆腐，旁边的油锅正在加热。
agedashi-dofu.en: Hands blot tofu with paper while a pot of oil heats nearby.

agedashi-dofu.zh: 手用漏铲轻翻油锅中三块浅金色的豆腐。
agedashi-dofu.en: A hand gently turns three pale golden tofu pieces in hot oil with a slotted spatula.

agedashi-dofu.zh: 手将炸豆腐放上网架，油滴落在下方的盘里。
agedashi-dofu.en: A hand transfers fried tofu to a wire rack as oil drips onto the tray below.

agedashi-dofu.zh: 手沿碗边浇汁，两碗豆腐上放着萝卜泥、姜泥、葱花和柴鱼片。
agedashi-dofu.en: A hand pours sauce along the edge of a bowl of tofu topped with daikon, ginger, scallions, and bonito flakes.

aglio-olio.zh: 用面勺拨散沸水中的意面。
aglio-olio.en: A hand separates spaghetti in boiling water with a pasta spoon.

aglio-olio.zh: 轻晃小火上的锅，油中蒜片边缘呈浅金色。
aglio-olio.en: A hand shakes a pan over low heat, with garlic slices turning light gold at the edges in oil.

aglio-olio.zh: 向蒜片和辣椒油中缓缓倒入煮面水。
aglio-olio.en: A hand slowly pours pasta water into oil with garlic slices and chili.

aglio-olio.zh: 用夹子提拌蒜油锅里的意面，旁边留有煮面水。
aglio-olio.en: A hand lifts and tosses spaghetti in garlic oil with tongs, with reserved pasta water nearby.

aglio-olio.zh: 中火用夹子翻拌意面，锅底留有少量浑浊薄汁。
aglio-olio.en: A hand tosses spaghetti over medium heat, leaving a little cloudy sauce in the pan.

aglio-olio.zh: 用夹子将拌有蒜片、辣椒和欧芹的意面装盘。
aglio-olio.en: A hand plates spaghetti with garlic slices, chili and parsley using tongs.

andong-jjimdak.zh: 手从水中提起泡软、能弯折的粉条。
andong-jjimdak.en: A hand lifts softened, flexible glass noodles from water.

andong-jjimdak.zh: 手切土豆块，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜和炖汁。
andong-jjimdak.en: Hands cut potato into chunks beside prepared vegetables and sauce.

andong-jjimdak.zh: 大火煮沸鸡块和炖汁，手正撇去浮沫。
andong-jjimdak.en: A hand skims foam from chicken and sauce boiling over high heat.

andong-jjimdak.zh: 鸡块和蔬菜在锅中炖煮，手用筷子扎土豆。
andong-jjimdak.en: A hand tests a potato with chopsticks as chicken and vegetables simmer.

andong-jjimdak.zh: 手用夹子翻动锅中透明的粉条、鸡块和蔬菜。
andong-jjimdak.en: A hand gently turns translucent noodles, chicken and vegetables with tongs.

andong-jjimdak.zh: 手向盛有炖鸡、蔬菜和粉条的锅中撒芝麻。
andong-jjimdak.en: A hand sprinkles sesame seeds over the pot of chicken, vegetables and noodles.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 手拌牛肉末和调味料，旁边备好洋葱丁与葱花。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A hand mixes ground beef with seasonings beside diced onion and scallion.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 手将水淀粉搅匀，旁边放着调好的料汁。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A hand stirs starch slurry until smooth beside a bowl of sauce.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 手用铲子托起翻面煎熟的鸡蛋。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A hand lifts the edge of a flipped fried egg with a spatula.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 手在锅中翻炒黄油和边缘微黄的洋葱丁。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A hand stirs diced onion with lightly golden edges in melted butter.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 手用锅铲炒散牛肉末和洋葱丁。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A hand stirs finely crumbled beef and diced onion with a spatula.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 手向冒泡的牛肉酱汁倒入水淀粉并推动肉末。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A hand pours starch slurry into bubbling beef sauce while stirring.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 锅铲划开肉末，稀薄发亮的酱汁流回空隙。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A spatula parts the beef as glossy thin sauce flows back into the gap.

ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.zh: 手将撒了葱花的煎蛋放在牛肉饭上。
ao-men-mian-zhi-niu-rou-fan.en: A hand places a scallion-topped fried egg on the beef and rice.

arancini.zh: 木勺划开浓稠的牛肉豌豆番茄酱。
arancini.en: A wooden spoon draws a channel through thick beef, pea and tomato sauce.

arancini.zh: 用木勺将奶酪丁拌入浓稠的牛肉豌豆馅。
arancini.en: A wooden spoon mixes cheese cubes into thick beef and pea filling.

arancini.zh: 用木勺将鸡蛋拌入藏红花米饭。
arancini.en: A wooden spoon mixes eggs into saffron rice.

arancini.zh: 双手将藏红花饭团合拢捏圆，旁边放着米饭和肉馅。
arancini.en: Two hands seal and shape a saffron rice ball beside rice and meat filling.

arancini.zh: 用手轻压饭团上的细面包糠，旁边放着蛋液。
arancini.en: A hand presses fine breadcrumbs onto a rice ball beside a bowl of beaten egg.

arancini.zh: 用漏勺翻动油锅中炸至金黄的饭团。
arancini.en: A slotted spoon turns golden rice balls in hot oil.

arista-alla-fiorentina.zh: 双手用棉线绑紧脂肪朝上的带骨猪通脊。
arista-alla-fiorentina.en: Hands tie a bone-in pork loin with its fat cap facing up.

arista-alla-fiorentina.zh: 双手将蒜和迷迭香碎塞入猪肉浅口，表面插着丁香。
arista-alla-fiorentina.en: Hands tuck chopped garlic and rosemary into slits in the pork beside two cloves.

arista-alla-fiorentina.zh: 用勺把烤盘中的融化脂肪淋在浅金色猪肉上。
arista-alla-fiorentina.en: A spoon bastes the lightly golden pork with rendered fat from the pan.

arista-alla-fiorentina.zh: 手从侧面将探针插入深金色烤猪肉测温。
arista-alla-fiorentina.en: A hand inserts a probe into the side of the deep golden pork roast.

arista-alla-fiorentina.zh: 戴烤箱手套的手扶住烤盘，探针插在烤猪肉侧面。
arista-alla-fiorentina.en: An oven-mitted hand holds the pan while a probe sits in the side of the roast.

arista-alla-fiorentina.zh: 手在案板上切烤猪肉，分离的肋骨放在一旁。
arista-alla-fiorentina.en: Hands slice the roast on a cutting board beside the separated ribs.

arista-alla-fiorentina.zh: 用勺把金色肉汁淋在盘中的烤猪肉片上。
arista-alla-fiorentina.en: A spoon pours golden pan juices over sliced roast pork on a platter.

ba-bao-fan.zh: 手指掐断泡软的糯米，旁边是沥干的莲子。
ba-bao-fan.en: A hand breaks a soaked rice grain beside a bowl of drained lotus seeds.

ba-bao-fan.zh: 用勺背压碎煮软的莲子，旁边摆着处理好的果料。
ba-bao-fan.en: A spoon crushes a soft cooked lotus seed beside the prepared fruit.

ba-bao-fan.zh: 向蒸布上膨起的糯米均匀洒热水。
ba-bao-fan.en: A hand sprinkles hot water over swollen rice on a steamer cloth.

ba-bao-fan.zh: 用勺轻拌热糯米饭，米粒完整发亮。
ba-bao-fan.en: A spoon gently folds hot glutinous rice until the intact grains glisten.

ba-bao-fan.zh: 用勺把红豆沙放进糯米饭中央的凹窝。
ba-bao-fan.en: A spoon places sweet red bean paste in the hollow of the rice.

ba-bao-fan.zh: 把封平的糯米饭放进出汽的蒸锅。
ba-bao-fan.en: Hands place the sealed bowl of rice in a steaming pot.

ba-bao-fan.zh: 双手提起倒扣的碗，露出果料圆顶。
ba-bao-fan.en: Hands lift the inverted bowl to reveal the fruit-topped rice dome.

ba-si-tu-dou.zh: 手将土豆块与干淀粉拌匀，表面薄薄发白。
ba-si-tu-dou.en: A hand tosses potato chunks with dry starch until lightly coated.

ba-si-tu-dou.zh: 手在盘子上抹油，旁边备有熟白芝麻。
ba-si-tu-dou.en: A hand oils a plate beside a small dish of toasted white sesame seeds.

ba-si-tu-dou.zh: 手用筷子翻动油中金黄的土豆块，油持续起泡。
ba-si-tu-dou.en: A hand turns golden potato chunks with chopsticks in steadily bubbling oil.

ba-si-tu-dou.zh: 炸好的土豆块用漏勺摊开在浅盘中。
ba-si-tu-dou.en: A slotted spoon spreads fried potato chunks apart in a shallow tray.

ba-si-tu-dou.zh: 手在小火上轻转锅，锅里的糖液清亮微沸。
ba-si-tu-dou.en: A hand gently tilts a wok of clear, lightly simmering syrup over low heat.

ba-si-tu-dou.zh: 手将锅端离炉灶，浅金色浓糖液冒着细泡。
ba-si-tu-dou.en: A hand lifts the wok off the stove, with fine bubbles in the pale golden syrup.

ba-si-tu-dou.zh: 筷子夹起裹糖和芝麻的土豆，拉出细丝。
ba-si-tu-dou.en: Chopsticks lift a sesame-topped glazed potato piece, drawing out fine sugar threads.

baechu-kimchi.zh: 双手掀开白菜叶，向白梗撒盐。
baechu-kimchi.en: Hands lift napa cabbage leaves and sprinkle salt on the white ribs.

baechu-kimchi.zh: 双手弯曲盐渍白菜的粗梗，检查是否柔韧。
baechu-kimchi.en: Hands bend a salted cabbage rib to check its flexibility.

baechu-kimchi.zh: 手举起木勺，锅中米糊冒泡并挂在勺上。
baechu-kimchi.en: A hand lifts a spoon of thick rice paste above a bubbling saucepan.

baechu-kimchi.zh: 手拌匀红色辣椒酱和萝卜丝、胡萝卜丝及葱段。
baechu-kimchi.en: A hand mixes red chili paste with radish, carrot and scallion pieces.

baechu-kimchi.zh: 戴手套的双手将辣椒酱和菜丝抹进白菜叶间。
baechu-kimchi.en: Gloved hands spread chili paste and vegetable strips between cabbage leaves.

baechu-kimchi.zh: 手把装有白菜泡菜的密封容器放进冰箱。
baechu-kimchi.en: A hand places a sealed container of napa cabbage kimchi in the refrigerator.

bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.zh: 双手将泡软沥干的粉条剪成短段。
bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.en: Hands cut softened, drained glass noodles into short lengths.

bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.zh: 双手斜切白菜帮，菜叶和五花肉分开放在案板上。
bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.en: Hands slice cabbage stalks diagonally, with leaves and pork belly kept separate on the board.

bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.zh: 锅中五花肉片铺开翻炒，边缘透亮并渗出油脂。
bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.en: Pork belly slices are spread out and turned in the wok, with translucent edges and rendered fat.

bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.zh: 将白菜帮倒入锅中，和上色的五花肉一起翻炒。
bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.en: Cabbage stalks are added to the wok with soy-colored pork belly.

bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.zh: 往没过五花肉和白菜帮的汤中撒入少许香料。
bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.en: A pinch of spice is sprinkled into broth covering pork belly and cabbage stalks.

bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.zh: 用锅铲轻推粉条，让它浸入白菜猪肉汤中。
bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.en: A spatula gently pushes glass noodles into the pork and cabbage broth.

bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.zh: 将白菜、五花肉和粉条连汤盛入碗中。
bai-cai-zhu-rou-dun-fen-tiao.en: Pork belly, cabbage and glass noodles are served with broth in a bowl.

bai-qie-ji.zh: 往大火滚沸的水中加盐，整鸡放在一旁。
bai-qie-ji.en: Salt is added to vigorously boiling water, with a whole chicken nearby.

bai-qie-ji.zh: 用夹子和漏勺将整鸡浸入水中，腹腔冒出气泡。
bai-qie-ji.en: Tongs and a slotted spoon lower a whole chicken into water as bubbles escape its cavity.

bai-qie-ji.zh: 锅边冒小泡，用探针测浸煮中的鸡腿。
bai-qie-ji.en: A probe checks the chicken thigh as small bubbles rise around the pot.

bai-qie-ji.zh: 用锅铲翻炒油中颜色仍浅的姜末和葱白。
bai-qie-ji.en: A spatula stirs pale minced ginger and scallion whites in oil.

bai-qie-ji.zh: 双手在冰水盆中翻动整只熟鸡。
bai-qie-ji.en: Two hands turn the whole cooked chicken in an ice bath.

bai-qie-ji.zh: 用筷子把鸡块摆上盘，旁边放着姜葱蓉。
bai-qie-ji.en: Chopsticks place a piece of chicken on the platter beside ginger scallion sauce.

bai-zhuo-cai-xin.zh: 手持刀处理菜心粗茎，旁边备有蒜末和辣椒碎。
bai-zhuo-cai-xin.en: Hands prepare thick choy sum stems beside bowls of minced garlic and chopped chili.

bai-zhuo-cai-xin.zh: 手把料汁搅匀，旁边另备盐和油。
bai-zhuo-cai-xin.en: Hands stir the sauce with salt and oil set aside.

bai-zhuo-cai-xin.zh: 锅里的水和油在大火上翻滚沸腾。
bai-zhuo-cai-xin.en: Water and oil boil vigorously in a pot over high heat.

bai-zhuo-cai-xin.zh: 手用夹子夹住菜叶，先把菜茎浸入沸水。
bai-zhuo-cai-xin.en: A hand holds the leaves with tongs while the stems blanch in boiling water.

bai-zhuo-cai-xin.zh: 手用夹子把沥水后的菜心码进盘里。
bai-zhuo-cai-xin.en: A hand uses tongs to arrange drained choy sum on a plate.

bai-zhuo-cai-xin.zh: 手把蒜辣料汁薄薄浇在盘中的菜心上。
bai-zhuo-cai-xin.en: A hand pours a little garlic and chili sauce over the plated choy sum.

bai-zhuo-xia.zh: 手将姜片铺在小锅的厚洋葱块上。
bai-zhuo-xia.en: A hand spreads ginger slices over thick onion chunks in a small pan.

bai-zhuo-xia.zh: 手向铺在洋葱姜片上的生虾淋料酒。
bai-zhuo-xia.en: A hand pours cooking wine over raw shrimp on a bed of onion and ginger.

bai-zhuo-xia.zh: 虾在盖着的锅中小火焖煮，盖内凝有水汽。
bai-zhuo-xia.en: Shrimp cook over a low flame under a lid beaded with condensation.

bai-zhuo-xia.zh: 筷子夹起一只虾，露出珠白不透明的虾肉。
bai-zhuo-xia.en: Chopsticks lift a shrimp to reveal opaque, pearly white flesh.

bai-zhuo-xia.zh: 手将热油淋入盛有葱花、蒜末和芝麻的碗中。
bai-zhuo-xia.en: A hand pours hot oil over scallions, minced garlic and sesame in a bowl.

bai-zhuo-xia.zh: 手用筷子将熟虾摆盘，旁边放着蘸汁。
bai-zhuo-xia.en: A hand arranges cooked shrimp on a plate beside a bowl of dipping sauce.

bang-bang-ji.zh: 手调小火，鸡胸、姜片和葱白在锅中微微起泡。
bang-bang-ji.en: A hand turns down the heat as chicken breasts, ginger, and scallion whites begin to bubble.

bang-bang-ji.zh: 手用探针测锅中鸡胸，旁边放着留出的鸡汤。
bang-bang-ji.en: A hand probes a chicken breast in the pot beside a bowl of reserved broth.

bang-bang-ji.zh: 手将鸡胸放入冰水，旁边的鸡汤正在冷却。
bang-bang-ji.en: A hand places a chicken breast in ice water beside cooling broth.

bang-bang-ji.zh: 手边倒入鸡汤边搅拌芝麻酱，旁边备着生抽、醋和糖。
bang-bang-ji.en: Hands stir sesame paste while adding broth, with soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar nearby.

bang-bang-ji.zh: 手将红油倒入芝麻酱汁并搅拌，旁边备着花椒面、蒜泥和姜泥。
bang-bang-ji.en: Hands stir chili oil into sesame sauce beside ground Sichuan pepper, garlic paste, and ginger paste.

bang-bang-ji.zh: 手用擀面杖轻敲鸡胸，案板上放着黄瓜丝和葱绿。
bang-bang-ji.en: A hand taps a chicken breast with a rolling pin beside cucumber strips and chopped scallions.

bang-bang-ji.zh: 手把怪味汁浇在铺有黄瓜丝和葱绿的鸡丝上。
bang-bang-ji.en: A hand pours sauce over shredded chicken on cucumber with chopped scallions.

banh-flan.zh: 手将琥珀色焦糖从小锅倒入圆模。
banh-flan.en: A hand pours amber caramel from a saucepan into a round mold.

banh-flan.zh: 手用打蛋器轻搅蛋奶液，旁边摆着用料。
banh-flan.en: A hand gently whisks the custard mixture beside its ingredients.

banh-flan.zh: 手将蛋奶液过筛，倒入铺有焦糖的圆模。
banh-flan.en: Hands strain the custard mixture into a round mold lined with caramel.

banh-flan.zh: 盖着铝箔的圆模在蒸锅中隔水小火蒸制。
banh-flan.en: A foil-covered mold steams on a rack above gently bubbling water.

banh-flan.zh: 双手轻晃圆模，检查凝固的布丁。
banh-flan.en: Hands gently shake the mold to check the set custard.

banh-flan.zh: 手揭起倒扣的圆模，焦糖汁流在布丁上。
banh-flan.en: A hand lifts the inverted mold from the flan as caramel runs over it.

banh-mi-thit.zh: 双手揉萝卜条，白萝卜条弯曲不断，碗底有汁水。
banh-mi-thit.en: Hands massage daikon and carrot strips; a daikon strip bends without breaking above the liquid in the bowl.

banh-mi-thit.zh: 往装有白萝卜和胡萝卜条的罐中倒入腌汁。
banh-mi-thit.en: Pickling liquid is poured into a jar of daikon and carrot strips.

banh-mi-thit.zh: 腌萝卜条在筛中沥汁，旁边摆着肉片、肝酱和鲜菜。
banh-mi-thit.en: Pickled vegetable strips drain in a sieve beside sliced meats, pâté and fresh vegetables.

banh-mi-thit.zh: 双手沿法棍长边切开面包，留一侧相连。
banh-mi-thit.en: Hands slice a baguette lengthwise, leaving one side attached.

banh-mi-thit.zh: 双手端出一盘切成两段的越南法棍三明治。
banh-mi-thit.en: Hands serve a plate holding two halves of a Vietnamese bánh mì sandwich.

banh-xeo.zh: 用勺舀起顺滑的葱花米浆，米浆流回碗中。
banh-xeo.en: A spoon lifts smooth scallion batter, which flows back into the bowl.

banh-xeo.zh: 将蒜末和辣椒圈加入鱼露汁，旁边放着生菜和香草。
banh-xeo.en: Minced garlic and chili rings are added to dipping sauce beside lettuce and herbs.

banh-xeo.zh: 向锅中熟透的猪肉和红葱头淋入鱼露，洋葱盛在一旁。
banh-xeo.en: Fish sauce is poured over cooked pork and shallots, with onions set aside.

banh-xeo.zh: 锅中虾仁变得不透明并卷曲，手正撒盐。
banh-xeo.en: Salt is sprinkled over opaque, curled shrimp in the pan.

banh-xeo.zh: 转动热锅，让起泡的葱花米浆薄薄铺满锅底。
banh-xeo.en: The hot pan is tilted to spread bubbling scallion batter thinly across its base.

banh-xeo.zh: 煎饼半边放着虾、猪肉、洋葱和豆芽，手沿边淋油。
banh-xeo.en: Oil is poured around the edge of a crepe topped on one half with shrimp, pork, onions and bean sprouts.

banh-xeo.zh: 用铲子将包着虾、猪肉和豆芽的煎饼送上盘，旁边有鲜菜和蘸汁。
banh-xeo.en: A spatula slides the shrimp, pork and bean sprout crepe onto a plate with greens and dipping sauce.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 手从冷水中捞起泡软的粉丝，旁边摆着切好的菜和香料。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: A hand lifts softened glass noodles from cold water beside prepared vegetables and aromatics.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 用筷子在沸水中拨散粉丝。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: Chopsticks separate glass noodles in boiling water.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 用筷子搅匀蛋液，旁边放着调好的酱汁和盐。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: Chopsticks beat the eggs beside mixed sauce and salt.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 用锅铲将刚凝固的软蛋块盛入碗中。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: A spatula transfers softly set scrambled eggs into a bowl.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 小火翻炒油中的葱、蒜和干辣椒。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: Scallions, garlic and dried chilies are stirred in oil over low heat.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 锅铲翻炒略软发亮的包菜丝和胡萝卜丝。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: A spatula tosses glossy, slightly softened cabbage and carrot strips.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 将调好的酱汁倒入粉丝和菜丝中。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: Mixed sauce is poured onto glass noodles and shredded vegetables.

bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.zh: 用锅铲将鸡蛋、粉丝和菜丝盛入盘中。
bao-cai-chao-ji-dan-fen-si.en: A spatula transfers the egg, glass noodles and vegetables onto a plate.

bearnaise.zh: 用勺压滤红葱头和龙蒿，收汁滴入碗中。
bearnaise.en: A spoon presses shallot and tarragon in a sieve, letting the reduction drip into a bowl.

bearnaise.zh: 黄油在小火上融化，旁边放着两份冷黄油。
bearnaise.en: Butter melts over low heat beside two portions of cold butter.

bearnaise.zh: 隔着微沸的水搅打蛋黄，蛋液变浓并留下纹路。
bearnaise.en: Egg yolks are whisked over gently simmering water until thick enough to leave trails.

bearnaise.zh: 一边细流加入融化黄油，一边搅打浓稠的酱。
bearnaise.en: Melted butter is poured in a thin stream while the thick sauce is whisked.

bearnaise.zh: 用勺将鲜龙蒿拌入金黄色的酱中。
bearnaise.en: Fresh tarragon is stirred into the golden sauce with a spoon.

bechamel.zh: 手将微微冒气的牛奶锅移离炉灶，旁边备有面粉、黄油和工具。
bechamel.en: A hand lifts steaming milk off the stove, with flour, butter and tools ready nearby.

bechamel.zh: 手用软铲搅动锅中浅色、细密起泡的黄油面粉糊。
bechamel.en: A hand stirs pale, finely bubbling butter and flour roux with a spatula.

bechamel.zh: 手将少量牛奶倒入离火的面糊，同时用打蛋器搅成稠膏。
bechamel.en: Hands pour a little milk into the off-heat roux and whisk it into a thick paste.

bechamel.zh: 手搅动微微冒泡的浓酱，打蛋器在表面留下浅纹。
bechamel.en: A hand whisks gently bubbling thick sauce, leaving shallow trails on its surface.

bechamel.zh: 勺背裹着一层酱，酱呈连续的带状流回轻轻冒泡的锅中。
bechamel.en: Sauce coats the back of a spoon and falls in a continuous ribbon into the gently bubbling pot.

bechamel.zh: 手在白酱上刨肉豆蔻，旁边放着盐和白胡椒。
bechamel.en: Hands grate nutmeg over white sauce, with salt and white pepper nearby.

beurre-blanc.zh: 锅中红葱头末在少量湿润的收汁中加热。
beurre-blanc.en: Minced shallots heat in a small amount of moist reduction.

beurre-blanc.zh: 一勺淡奶油倒入微微沸腾的红葱头收汁。
beurre-blanc.en: A spoonful of cream is poured into bubbling shallot reduction.

beurre-blanc.zh: 离火搅拌黄油块，锅中酱汁呈乳白色。
beurre-blanc.en: Butter cubes are whisked into milky sauce off the heat.

beurre-blanc.zh: 手向浓稠光亮的酱汁撒盐和白胡椒。
beurre-blanc.en: A hand sprinkles salt and white pepper into the thick, glossy sauce.

beurre-blanc.zh: 黄油白酱从小锅倒入白色红边酱汁船。
beurre-blanc.en: Beurre blanc is poured from a saucepan into a white gravy boat with a red rim.

bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.zh: 用剪刀剪开生虾背壳，旁边的碗里放着生虾。
bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.en: Hands cut open the back shell of a raw shrimp beside a bowl of shrimp.

bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.zh: 用漏勺捞出炸至壳红肉白的虾，旁边放着网架。
bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.en: A skimmer lifts red-shelled shrimp with opaque white flesh from the oil beside a rack.

bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.zh: 用漏勺捞出复炸的虾，油面只剩少量气泡。
bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.en: A skimmer lifts refried shrimp from oil with only a few bubbles remaining.

bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.zh: 锅中翻炒姜末、蒜末和红辣椒，蒜末边缘浅黄。
bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.en: Minced ginger, garlic and red chili are stirred in oil until the garlic edges are pale yellow.

bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.zh: 锅中翻拌金黄松散的面包糠、蒜末和辣椒。
bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.en: Golden loose breadcrumbs, minced garlic and chili are stirred in the pan.

bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.zh: 将裹着金黄碎屑的虾盛入宽盘，撒有葱花和辣椒。
bi-feng-tang-chao-xia.en: Crumb-coated shrimp with scallion and chili are served on a wide platter.

bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.zh: 用厨房纸吸干划过刀的鳊鱼表面，旁边放着姜片。
bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.en: A hand pats a scored bream dry with kitchen paper beside ginger slices.

bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.zh: 把豆腐切块，旁边摆着清水、葱、蒜、冰糖和香料。
bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.en: Hands cut tofu into blocks beside water, scallions, garlic, rock sugar and spices.

bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.zh: 用宽铲托起锅中煎至金黄的鳊鱼。
bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.en: A broad spatula supports the golden pan-fried bream.

bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.zh: 把鱼推到锅边，在空处翻炒葱姜蒜和香料。
bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.en: A hand stirs scallions, ginger, garlic and spices beside the fish in the pan.

bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.zh: 把豆腐块放入鱼周围的沸腾汤汁中。
bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.en: A hand places tofu around the fish in bubbling broth.

bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.zh: 锅边冒着小泡，用勺子往鱼身上浇汤。
bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.en: A hand spoons broth over the fish as small bubbles form at the pan edge.

bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.zh: 将汤汁淋在盘中的鳊鱼和豆腐上。
bian-yu-dun-dou-fu.en: A hand pours sauce over the plated bream and tofu.

bibim-guksu.zh: 手将全熟鸡蛋剖开，蛋黄和蛋白均已凝固。
bibim-guksu.en: Hands cut a hard-boiled egg, revealing a fully set yolk and white.

bibim-guksu.zh: 手用勺舀起浓稠红酱，旁边放着黄瓜丝。
bibim-guksu.en: A hand lifts thick red sauce with a spoon beside sliced cucumber.

bibim-guksu.zh: 手用筷子拨散大火沸水中的细面。
bibim-guksu.en: A hand separates thin noodles with chopsticks in vigorously boiling water.

bibim-guksu.zh: 手在冷水下用筷子轻轻拨开筛网里的面条。
bibim-guksu.en: A hand gently separates noodles in a strainer under running cold water.

bibim-guksu.zh: 手将盛有松散面条的筛网举在空碗上沥水。
bibim-guksu.en: A hand holds a strainer of loose noodles over an empty bowl to drain.

bibim-guksu.zh: 手把半个熟蛋放在铺有黄瓜丝和芝麻的红面上。
bibim-guksu.en: A hand places half a boiled egg on red noodles topped with cucumber and sesame.

bibimbap.zh: 用筷子拌匀牛肉和调味料，旁边是盐渍的西葫芦片和黄瓜片。
bibimbap.en: A hand mixes beef and seasonings while salted zucchini and cucumber slices sit nearby.

bibimbap.zh: 揭开锅盖，黄豆芽在大火上煮熟冒出热气。
bibimbap.en: A hand lifts the lid from steaming soybean sprouts cooking over high heat.

bibimbap.zh: 用夹子从沸水中捞出焯至塌下的菠菜。
bibimbap.en: A hand lifts wilted spinach from boiling water with tongs.

bibimbap.zh: 锅中翻炒红甜椒条，旁边分别放着西葫芦片和黄瓜片。
bibimbap.en: A hand stir-fries red bell pepper strips beside bowls of zucchini and cucumber slices.

bibimbap.zh: 往锅中炒软的蕨菜段加入酱汁，锅里可见蒜末。
bibimbap.en: A hand adds sauce to softened fernbrake and minced garlic in a skillet.

bibimbap.zh: 用锅铲翻炒已变褐色的牛肉条，旁边放着鸡蛋。
bibimbap.en: A hand turns browned beef strips in a skillet beside a bowl of eggs.

bibimbap.zh: 石锅里的米饭铺着牛肉、蔬菜、熟蛋和辣椒酱，在火上加热。
bibimbap.en: Rice topped with beef, vegetables, a cooked egg and chili paste heats in a stone pot.

bibimbap.zh: 用勺拌开石锅饭，刮起一片金黄锅巴。
bibimbap.en: A hand mixes the rice in a stone pot and lifts a golden piece of crisp rice.

bing-fen.zh: 手将澄清石灰水倒入碗中，白色沉淀留在杯底。
bing-fen.en: A hand pours clear limewater into a bowl, leaving white sediment in the cup.

bing-fen.zh: 手将包紧冰粉籽的纱布袋放入清水中。
bing-fen.en: A hand lowers a tightly tied bag of ice jelly seeds into clean water.

bing-fen.zh: 双手挤压籽袋，黏液滴入有细泡的水中。
bing-fen.en: Two hands squeeze the seed bag, releasing viscous liquid into bubbly water.

bing-fen.zh: 一手倒入澄清石灰水，一手轻搅盆中液体。
bing-fen.en: One hand pours in clear limewater while the other gently stirs the liquid.

bing-fen.zh: 手向离火的糖水撒桂花，旁边放着柠檬汁和盐。
bing-fen.en: A hand sprinkles osmanthus into syrup off the heat, with lemon juice and salt nearby.

bing-fen.zh: 手将桂花糖水浇在碗里的透明冰粉块上。
bing-fen.en: A hand pours osmanthus syrup over translucent ice jelly in a bowl.

bing-tang-hu-lu.zh: 用厨房纸轻轻吸干去核的山楂。
bing-tang-hu-lu.en: A hand gently pats pitted hawthorns dry with kitchen paper.

bing-tang-hu-lu.zh: 用竹签串起合拢的山楂，旁边备好冷水。
bing-tang-hu-lu.en: Hands thread reassembled hawthorns onto a bamboo skewer beside a bowl of cold water.

bing-tang-hu-lu.zh: 小锅中的透明糖液在中火上沸腾。
bing-tang-hu-lu.en: Clear sugar syrup boils in a small saucepan over medium heat.

bing-tang-hu-lu.zh: 浅黄色糖液密集起泡，用竹签在冷水中试糖。
bing-tang-hu-lu.en: Pale yellow syrup bubbles densely as a hand tests it with a skewer in cold water.

bing-tang-hu-lu.zh: 倾斜离火的锅，将山楂串转动着蘸上糖液。
bing-tang-hu-lu.en: A hand turns a hawthorn skewer in syrup pooled in a tilted saucepan off the heat.

bing-tang-hu-lu.zh: 从烘焙纸上揭起冷却的糖葫芦，旁边盘中放着两串。
bing-tang-hu-lu.en: A hand lifts a cooled candied hawthorn skewer from parchment beside two plated skewers.

bisque-de-homard.zh: 用钳子掰开生龙虾钳壳，旁边放着切段的尾部。
bisque-de-homard.en: Hands crack a raw lobster claw beside the segmented tail.

bisque-de-homard.zh: 锅中翻炒龙虾块、胡萝卜丁和洋葱丁，虾壳变红。
bisque-de-homard.en: Lobster pieces, diced carrot and onion are stirred in a pan as the shells turn red.

bisque-de-homard.zh: 龙虾和香料袋在锅中微沸，虾肉已变白。
bisque-de-homard.en: Lobster and an herb sachet simmer gently in a pot, with the meat turning white.

bisque-de-homard.zh: 用勺轻搅鸡汤中煮软的米。
bisque-de-homard.en: A spoon gently stirs softened rice in chicken stock.

bisque-de-homard.zh: 用勺压细筛中的龙虾壳，让汤汁流入碗中。
bisque-de-homard.en: A spoon presses lobster shells in a fine sieve, letting stock drain into a bowl.

bisque-de-homard.zh: 用手持搅拌棒在锅中打细龙虾汤、软米和虾肉。
bisque-de-homard.en: An immersion blender purées lobster stock, softened rice and lobster meat in an open pot.

bisque-de-homard.zh: 将橙色龙虾浓汤舀入碗中，碗里有虾肉块。
bisque-de-homard.en: Orange lobster bisque is ladled into a bowl containing pieces of lobster meat.

blanquette-de-veau.zh: 用漏勺撇去微沸的牛肉锅里的浮沫。
blanquette-de-veau.en: A hand skims foam from gently simmering veal.

blanquette-de-veau.zh: 用叉子检查清汤中与蔬菜轻煨的牛肉。
blanquette-de-veau.en: A hand tests veal simmering in stock with vegetables using a fork.

blanquette-de-veau.zh: 揭开小锅盖，查看原汁中轻煨的小白洋葱。
blanquette-de-veau.en: A hand lifts the lid to check pearl onions simmering in their cooking liquid.

blanquette-de-veau.zh: 小火搅拌浅色、均匀起泡的黄油面粉糊。
blanquette-de-veau.en: A hand stirs pale, evenly bubbling butter and flour over low heat.

blanquette-de-veau.zh: 舀起白汁，查看它挂在勺背上的浓稠度。
blanquette-de-veau.en: A hand lifts a spoon to check the creamy sauce coating its back.

blanquette-de-veau.zh: 将白汁牛肉、蘑菇和小洋葱舀入盘中。
blanquette-de-veau.en: A hand ladles veal, mushrooms and pearl onions in white sauce into a bowl.

bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.zh: 把菠菜粗茎放入沸水，叶片放在一旁。
bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.en: A hand adds spinach stems to boiling water, with the leaves waiting nearby.

bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.zh: 夹起沥水篮中柔软的菠菜，水滴落下。
bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.en: Tongs lift wilted spinach from a draining colander as water drips below.

bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.zh: 把打匀的蛋液倒入热油锅中摊开。
bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.en: Beaten egg is poured into an oiled hot wok and spreads into a pancake.

bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.zh: 用铲子把凝固的蛋饼分成大块。
bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.en: A spatula divides the set egg pancake into large pieces.

bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.zh: 大火翻炒沥干的菠菜，蛋块盛在一旁。
bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.en: Drained spinach is stir-fried over high heat, with cooked egg set aside.

bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.zh: 轻翻菠菜和蛋块，锅中汤汁重新沸腾。
bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.en: Spinach and egg are gently stirred in visibly boiling liquid.

bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.zh: 将菠菜、蛋块和少量汤汁盛入盘中。
bo-cai-chao-ji-dan.en: Spinach, egg and a little broth are served onto a plate.

bo-kho.zh: 用勺拌匀腌料和生牛肉，旁边备好香料和胡萝卜。
bo-kho.en: A spoon mixes raw beef with marinade beside prepared aromatics and carrots.

bo-kho.zh: 锅中翻炒蒜末、香茅、八角和桂皮。
bo-kho.en: A spoon stirs minced garlic, lemongrass, star anise and cinnamon in a pot.

bo-kho.zh: 锅中翻炒裹匀番茄膏的牛肉和香料。
bo-kho.en: A spoon stirs beef coated in tomato paste with aromatics in a pot.

bo-kho.zh: 小火慢炖牛肉，叉子插入肉块检查软度。
bo-kho.en: A fork tests a beef cube in gently simmering broth.

bo-kho.zh: 小火将胡萝卜块拌入牛肉汤中。
bo-kho.en: A spoon stirs carrot chunks into gently simmering beef stew.

bo-kho.zh: 勺子舀起略浓的汤汁，锅里有牛肉和胡萝卜。
bo-kho.en: A spoon lifts lightly thickened sauce above beef and carrots in the pot.

bo-luc-lac.zh: 用勺拌匀牛肉块，使蒜香腌料薄薄裹住肉面。
bo-luc-lac.en: Toss beef cubes with a spoon until thinly coated in the garlic marinade.

bo-luc-lac.zh: 将红葱头薄片倒入酸甜汁，西洋菜另放。
bo-luc-lac.en: Pour sliced shallots into the sweet and sour dressing, keeping the watercress separate.

bo-luc-lac.zh: 用夹子将腌好的生牛肉块分散放入热油锅。
bo-luc-lac.en: Use tongs to space marinated raw beef cubes in the hot oiled pan.

bo-luc-lac.zh: 用锅铲翻起牛肉块，露出煎褐的底面。
bo-luc-lac.en: Turn a beef cube with a spatula to reveal its browned underside.

bo-luc-lac.zh: 用锅铲翻煎第二批牛肉，第一批盛在碗中。
bo-luc-lac.en: Turn the second batch of beef while the first batch rests in a bowl.

bo-luc-lac.zh: 将煎好的牛肉和肉汁倒在西洋菜与红葱头上，旁边配米饭。
bo-luc-lac.en: Pour seared beef and its juices over watercress and shallots, with rice alongside.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 用木勺盛起锅里略微煎黄的培根粗条。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: A wooden spoon lifts lightly browned bacon strips from the pot.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 用夹子翻动锅里间隔摆放的褐色牛肉块。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: Tongs turn spaced-out browned beef cubes in the pot.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 往煎褐的牛肉、培根、胡萝卜和洋葱上撒面粉。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: Flour is sprinkled over browned beef, bacon, carrots and onions.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 用木勺刮锅底，牛肉浸在红酒高汤中微微冒泡。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: A wooden spoon scrapes the pot as beef gently simmers in wine and stock.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 用叉子扭开炖软的牛肉块。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: A fork twists apart a tender piece of braised beef.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 揭开锅盖，完整的小洋葱在少量汤汁中焖软。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: A lid is lifted to reveal whole pearl onions braising in a little stock.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 用木铲翻炒锅里表面金黄的蘑菇。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: A wooden spatula turns golden mushrooms in a skillet.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 从小锅中舀起酱汁，勺背薄薄挂着一层。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: A spoon lifted from a saucepan is thinly coated with sauce.

boeuf-bourguignon.zh: 往牛肉、培根、小洋葱和蘑菇上撒碎欧芹。
boeuf-bourguignon.en: Chopped parsley is scattered over beef, bacon, pearl onions and mushrooms.

bossam.zh: 手在锅中搅开大酱，旁边放着两条生五花肉。
bossam.en: A hand stirs soybean paste into the pot beside two raw pork belly strips.

bossam.zh: 葱姜蒜和洋葱在大酱汤中持续沸腾。
bossam.en: Scallions, ginger, garlic and onion boil in soybean paste broth.

bossam.zh: 两条五花肉在汤中轻煮，一只手撇去浮沫。
bossam.en: A hand skims foam while two pork belly strips simmer gently in broth.

bossam.zh: 一只手用筷子试探锅中整条五花肉的软度。
bossam.en: A hand tests the tenderness of a whole pork belly strip with a chopstick.

bossam.zh: 五花肉在汤中静置，一只手将生菜装盘，旁边是泡菜和小虾。
bossam.en: Pork belly rests in broth while a hand plates lettuce beside kimchi and salted shrimp.

bossam.zh: 一双手将五花肉切片，旁边摆着生菜、肉片、泡菜和小虾。
bossam.en: Hands slice pork belly beside a platter of lettuce and pork with kimchi and salted shrimp.

bruschetta-al-pomodoro.zh: 双手将去籽番茄肉切成小丁，旁边的碗里盛着番茄丁。
bruschetta-al-pomodoro.en: Hands dice deseeded tomato flesh beside a bowl of diced tomato.

bruschetta-al-pomodoro.zh: 双手撕碎罗勒叶，案板旁放着拍裂去皮的蒜瓣。
bruschetta-al-pomodoro.en: Hands tear basil leaves beside peeled, lightly cracked garlic cloves on a board.

bruschetta-al-pomodoro.zh: 一只手将单层面包片推入上火烧烤的烤箱。
bruschetta-al-pomodoro.en: A hand slides a single layer of bread slices under the oven broiler.

bruschetta-al-pomodoro.zh: 一只手用夹子翻动烤架上表面金黄的面包片。
bruschetta-al-pomodoro.en: A hand uses tongs to turn a bread slice with a golden toasted surface on the rack.

bruschetta-al-pomodoro.zh: 一只手用蒜瓣轻擦金黄烤面包的表面。
bruschetta-al-pomodoro.en: A hand gently rubs a garlic clove over the surface of golden toast.

bruschetta-al-pomodoro.zh: 一只手在铺有番茄丁和罗勒的烤面包上淋橄榄油。
bruschetta-al-pomodoro.en: A hand drizzles olive oil over toast topped with diced tomato and basil.

bruschetta-al-pomodoro.zh: 白色椭圆盘上盛着三片番茄罗勒烤面包。
bruschetta-al-pomodoro.en: Three tomato and basil bruschetta sit on a white oval plate.

budae-jjigae.zh: 手在案板上拨散培根，旁边摆着切好的锅料。
budae-jjigae.en: A hand separates bacon on a board beside the prepared ingredients.

budae-jjigae.zh: 手用勺搅拌红色调味糊，旁边放着两碗鸡汤。
budae-jjigae.en: A hand stirs red seasoning paste beside two bowls of chicken stock.

budae-jjigae.zh: 手往摆好肉菜和调味糊的浅锅里倒入鸡汤。
budae-jjigae.en: A hand pours chicken stock into a shallow pan of meat, vegetables and seasoning paste.

budae-jjigae.zh: 手用勺在冒泡的部队锅中央化开调味糊。
budae-jjigae.en: A hand dissolves seasoning paste in the center of the bubbling stew.

budae-jjigae.zh: 手用筷子从沸水锅中捞起刚拨散的面条沥水。
budae-jjigae.en: A hand lifts loosened noodles from boiling water with chopsticks to drain.

budae-jjigae.zh: 手用筷子拨动部队锅里的面条，葱段和肉菜浸在汤中。
budae-jjigae.en: A hand moves noodles with chopsticks in simmering stew with scallions, meat and vegetables.

budae-jjigae.zh: 手从部队锅中夹起面条，融化的奶酪贴在面上。
budae-jjigae.en: A hand lifts noodles from the stew, with melted cheese resting on top.

bulgogi.zh: 用刀逆着纹路将有油花的牛肉切成薄片。
bulgogi.en: A cook cuts marbled beef across the grain into thin slices.

bulgogi.zh: 料理机把梨、洋葱、蒜和姜打成细腻果泥。
bulgogi.en: A food processor blends pear, onion, garlic and ginger into a smooth puree.

bulgogi.zh: 用筷子将牛肉薄片与果泥、葱和调味料拌匀。
bulgogi.en: A cook mixes thin beef slices with fruit puree, scallions and seasonings using chopsticks.

bulgogi.zh: 用夹子将腌好的牛肉分散铺入热锅。
bulgogi.en: A cook uses tongs to spread marinated beef slices apart in a hot pan.

bulgogi.zh: 用夹子翻动锅中边缘变褐、仍湿润的牛肉。
bulgogi.en: A cook turns moist beef slices with browned edges in a skillet.

bulgogi.zh: 用夹子翻动烤网上已上色的牛肉薄片。
bulgogi.en: A cook turns browned thin beef slices on a grill basket.

bulgogi.zh: 在盘中的熟牛肉上撒芝麻，旁边放着生菜。
bulgogi.en: A cook sprinkles sesame seeds over cooked beef beside a bowl of lettuce.

bun-bo-hue.zh: 大火煮牛骨和猪蹄，舀去锅面浮沫。
bun-bo-hue.en: Skim foam from beef bones and pork trotters boiling over high heat.

bun-bo-hue.zh: 用筷子试探微沸汤中的牛腱是否软透。
bun-bo-hue.en: Test the beef shank with chopsticks as the broth gently simmers.

bun-bo-hue.zh: 将拍裂的香茅段放入微沸的牛骨汤。
bun-bo-hue.en: Add bruised lemongrass pieces to gently simmering beef bone broth.

bun-bo-hue.zh: 将虾酱上层清液倒入汤中，留下底渣。
bun-bo-hue.en: Pour the clear shrimp paste liquid into the broth, leaving sediment behind.

bun-bo-hue.zh: 小火搅煮红亮的辣椒香茅油。
bun-bo-hue.en: Stir the glossy red chili lemongrass oil over low heat.

bun-bo-hue.zh: 从沸水中夹起煮软的粗圆米线。
bun-bo-hue.en: Lift softened thick round rice noodles from boiling water.

bun-bo-hue.zh: 将热汤浇入铺有牛肉和猪蹄的米线碗。
bun-bo-hue.en: Ladle hot broth into rice noodles topped with beef and pork trotter.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 筷子拌匀调味牛肉，香茅末单独放在一旁。
bun-bo-xao.en: Chopsticks mix seasoned beef while minced lemongrass sits separately.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 漏勺从油锅中捞起浅金黄的红葱头薄片。
bun-bo-xao.en: A skimmer lifts pale golden shallot slices from the oil.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 手持去籽黄瓜条蘸取带蒜末和辣椒的鱼露汁。
bun-bo-xao.en: A hand dips deseeded cucumber into fish sauce with garlic and chili.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 漏勺从沸水中捞起烫好的绿豆芽。
bun-bo-xao.en: A skimmer lifts blanched mung bean sprouts from boiling water.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 筛中的细米线在水龙头下冲凉。
bun-bo-xao.en: Thin rice vermicelli is rinsed under cold running water in a sieve.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 锅中翻炒香茅末，旁边备好三碗米线和蔬菜。
bun-bo-xao.en: Minced lemongrass is stirred in a pan beside three bowls of noodles and vegetables.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 锅中牛肉薄片分散铺开，边缘微褐。
bun-bo-xao.en: Thin beef slices lie apart in the pan with lightly browned edges.

bun-bo-xao.zh: 手将鱼露汁淋在铺有牛肉、花生和红葱头的米线上。
bun-bo-xao.en: A hand pours fish sauce over noodles topped with beef, peanuts and fried shallots.

bun-cha.zh: 手把米醋倒入青木瓜和胡萝卜片中。
bun-cha.en: A hand pours rice vinegar over sliced green papaya and carrot.

bun-cha.zh: 离火的深褐色糖色中缓缓倒入热水。
bun-cha.en: Hot water is slowly poured into dark caramel off the heat.

bun-cha.zh: 手将腌料拌入猪肉末，旁边是腌好的五花肉片。
bun-cha.en: A hand mixes marinade into ground pork beside marinated pork belly slices.

bun-cha.zh: 手把鱼露倒入蘸汁，辣椒圈另放一旁。
bun-cha.en: A hand pours fish sauce into dipping sauce beside a dish of chili rings.

bun-cha.zh: 手将米线小束摆在生菜、薄荷和香菜旁。
bun-cha.en: A hand arranges a bundle of rice vermicelli beside lettuce, mint, and cilantro.

bun-cha.zh: 手将温度探针插入烤架上的肉饼，旁边烤着肉片。
bun-cha.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into a patty grilling beside pork slices.

bun-cha.zh: 手将蘸汁倒入烤肉和腌菜碗中，米线与香草另放。
bun-cha.en: A hand pours dipping sauce over grilled pork and pickles beside noodles and herbs.

bun-rieu.zh: 手用石杵将蟹身捣成细浆，旁边放着蟹膏和盐。
bun-rieu.en: A hand pounds crab into a fine paste beside bowls of roe and salt.

bun-rieu.zh: 蟹水缓缓倒入锅中，粗壳渣留在碗底。
bun-rieu.en: Crab liquid pours slowly into a pot, leaving coarse shell fragments in the bowl.

bun-rieu.zh: 漏勺从清汤中捞出浮起的蟹块，放入碗中。
bun-rieu.en: A slotted spoon lifts floating crab curds from clear broth into a bowl.

bun-rieu.zh: 锅中翻炒橙黄蟹膏和红葱末，勺中倒入鱼露。
bun-rieu.en: Orange crab roe and minced shallots sizzle as fish sauce is poured into the pan.

bun-rieu.zh: 锅中碎番茄炒软出汁，油变红，旁边备着番茄瓣。
bun-rieu.en: Chopped tomatoes soften in red oil beside a bowl of tomato wedges.

bun-rieu.zh: 筷子从沸水中夹起柔软的细米线。
bun-rieu.en: Chopsticks lift soft thin rice noodles from boiling water.

bun-rieu.zh: 蟹汤沿碗边浇入米线和蟹块，旁边放着配菜。
bun-rieu.en: Crab broth is poured along the edge of a bowl of noodles and crab curds, with garnishes alongside.

bun-thit-nuong.zh: 双手揉拌猪肉条，使其裹满蒜葱腌料。
bun-thit-nuong.en: Hands massage pork strips until coated with garlic and shallot marinade.

bun-thit-nuong.zh: 手将辣椒圈倒入琥珀色鱼露蘸汁。
bun-thit-nuong.en: A hand adds chili rings to amber fish sauce dressing.

bun-thit-nuong.zh: 筷子挑起柔软的米线，旁边是沥干的豆芽。
bun-thit-nuong.en: Chopsticks lift tender rice noodles beside drained bean sprouts.

bun-thit-nuong.zh: 筷子将米线铺在鲜菜和香草上。
bun-thit-nuong.en: Chopsticks spread rice noodles over vegetables and herbs.

bun-thit-nuong.zh: 烤夹翻动烤架上褐香微焦的猪肉条。
bun-thit-nuong.en: Tongs turn browned, lightly charred pork strips on a grill.

bun-thit-nuong.zh: 手将花生碎撒在烤猪肉米线上，蘸汁另放。
bun-thit-nuong.en: A hand sprinkles crushed peanuts over grilled pork and rice noodles, with sauce on the side.

buri-teriyaki.zh: 用厨房纸压干盐渍后渗水的鰤鱼片。
buri-teriyaki.en: Pat the salted yellowtail fillets dry with kitchen paper.

buri-teriyaki.zh: 抖去鰤鱼片表面的余粉，旁边备好照烧汁和空盘。
buri-teriyaki.en: Shake excess flour from a yellowtail fillet beside prepared sauce and an empty plate.

buri-teriyaki.zh: 用锅铲轻抬鱼片，查看煎至金黄的底面。
buri-teriyaki.en: Lift a fillet with a spatula to check its golden underside.

buri-teriyaki.zh: 用夹子夹厨房纸吸去锅底余油，鱼肉侧面已不透明。
buri-teriyaki.en: Use tongs and kitchen paper to absorb excess oil beside the opaque fish.

buri-teriyaki.zh: 用勺将起密泡的照烧汁浇在鱼片上。
buri-teriyaki.en: Spoon bubbling teriyaki sauce over the fillets.

buri-teriyaki.zh: 用宽锅铲托鱼片装盘，再淋上亮汁。
buri-teriyaki.en: Transfer the glazed fish to a plate with a wide spatula and spoon sauce over it.

buta-no-shogayaki.zh: 双手擦姜泥，旁边摆着卷心菜丝、洋葱片和姜汁。
buta-no-shogayaki.en: Hands grate ginger beside shredded cabbage, sliced onion and ginger juice.

buta-no-shogayaki.zh: 双手分开沾有腌汁的生猪肉薄片。
buta-no-shogayaki.en: Hands separate thin raw pork slices lightly coated with marinade.

buta-no-shogayaki.zh: 双手搅拌带姜泥和洋葱泥的棕色酱汁。
buta-no-shogayaki.en: Hands stir brown sauce with grated ginger and onion.

buta-no-shogayaki.zh: 筷子翻动单层煎制的猪肉薄片，肉边发白并有金黄斑点。
buta-no-shogayaki.en: Chopsticks turn thin pork slices frying in a single layer, with pale edges and golden spots.

buta-no-shogayaki.zh: 锅铲翻炒变软、边缘浅金黄的洋葱片。
buta-no-shogayaki.en: A spatula stirs softened onion slices with lightly golden edges.

buta-no-shogayaki.zh: 勺子将锅中发亮的姜味酱汁舀到猪肉和洋葱上。
buta-no-shogayaki.en: A spoon bastes pork and onions with glossy ginger sauce in the pan.

buta-no-shogayaki.zh: 勺子将酱汁淋在猪肉和洋葱上，旁边是卷心菜丝。
buta-no-shogayaki.en: A spoon drizzles sauce over pork and onions beside shredded cabbage.

ca-chien-sot-ca.zh: 手在鱼片上薄拍玉米淀粉，鱼肉已撒盐和胡椒。
ca-chien-sot-ca.en: A hand pats a thin layer of cornstarch onto seasoned fish fillets.

ca-chien-sot-ca.zh: 鱼片在油中煎第一面，锅铲托起露出金黄底面。
ca-chien-sot-ca.en: Fish sizzles in oil as a spatula lifts an edge to reveal its golden underside.

ca-chien-sot-ca.zh: 鱼片煎至金黄，锅铲托起一块不透明的鱼肉。
ca-chien-sot-ca.en: A spatula lifts a golden fillet with opaque, flaky flesh from the pan.

ca-chien-sot-ca.zh: 锅铲划过冒泡的番茄酱底，露出锅底。
ca-chien-sot-ca.en: A spatula draws a path through bubbling tomato sauce with shallot and garlic.

ca-chien-sot-ca.zh: 手将番茄汁浇在金黄鱼片中央，盘中撒有葱花。
ca-chien-sot-ca.en: A hand spoons tomato sauce over golden fish fillets sprinkled with scallions.

ca-kho-to.zh: 手把热水缓缓倒入离火的深褐色糖色中。
ca-kho-to.en: A hand slowly pours hot water into deep brown caramel off the heat.

ca-kho-to.zh: 手在碗中拌匀鱼段与深色腌汁。
ca-kho-to.en: A hand coats fish steaks with dark marinade in a bowl.

ca-kho-to.zh: 手在金属锅中翻动油里微微金黄的蒜片和葱白。
ca-kho-to.en: A hand stirs lightly golden garlic slices and scallion whites in oil in a metal pan.

ca-kho-to.zh: 手掀开砂锅盖，查看少量汁水中的鱼段。
ca-kho-to.en: A hand lifts the clay pot lid to check fish steaks in a little liquid.

ca-kho-to.zh: 手向小火上的砂锅倒水，锅里鱼段浸在深色汤汁中。
ca-kho-to.en: A hand pours water into a clay pot where fish steaks simmer in dark broth.

ca-kho-to.zh: 砂锅里的鱼段裹着深亮酱汁，小火收浓。
ca-kho-to.en: Fish steaks are coated in glossy dark sauce reducing over low heat in a clay pot.

ca-kho-to.zh: 手将酱汁浇在盘中鱼段上，旁边是一碗白米饭。
ca-kho-to.en: A hand spoons sauce over plated fish steaks beside a bowl of white rice.

ca-phe-sua-da.zh: 手轻晃滤杯，将咖啡粉铺平，旁边备有空杯和冰块。
ca-phe-sua-da.en: A hand gently shakes the phin to level the coffee grounds, with an empty cup and ice nearby.

ca-phe-sua-da.zh: 手将压片放在咖啡粉上，滤杯稳放在耐热杯上。
ca-phe-sua-da.en: A hand places the press on the coffee grounds in a phin resting on a heatproof cup.

ca-phe-sua-da.zh: 小壶在炉上加热，水持续翻滚。
ca-phe-sua-da.en: Water boils vigorously in a small kettle on the stove.

ca-phe-sua-da.zh: 手向滤杯倒热水润湿咖啡粉，咖啡开始滴入杯中。
ca-phe-sua-da.en: A hand pours hot water into the phin to wet the grounds as coffee begins to drip into the cup.

ca-phe-sua-da.zh: 盖好的滤杯向耐热杯中缓慢滴出咖啡。
ca-phe-sua-da.en: Coffee slowly drips from the covered phin into a heatproof cup.

ca-phe-sua-da.zh: 手搅拌冰块与深棕色咖啡，滤杯放在旁边。
ca-phe-sua-da.en: A hand stirs ice and deep brown coffee in a glass, with the phin beside it.

ca-ri-ga.zh: 双手拌匀裹着黄色腌料的鸡块，旁边摆着备好的配料。
ca-ri-ga.en: Hands mix chicken coated in yellow marinade beside the prepared ingredients.

ca-ri-ga.zh: 用木铲翻拌鸡块与锅中的香茅、蒜和红葱头。
ca-ri-ga.en: A wooden spatula tosses chicken with lemongrass, garlic and shallot in the pot.

ca-ri-ga.zh: 用筷子拨松汤锅里骨边的鸡肉。
ca-ri-ga.en: Chopsticks pull tender chicken away from the bone in a pot of broth.

ca-ri-ga.zh: 用叉子试锅中土豆，鸡肉和蔬菜在咖喱汤里小火煮着。
ca-ri-ga.en: A fork tests a potato while chicken and vegetables simmer in curry broth.

ca-ri-ga.zh: 往盛好的咖喱鸡上撒香菜，旁边配着法棍。
ca-ri-ga.en: A hand scatters cilantro over a bowl of chicken curry beside sliced baguette.

cacio-e-pepe.zh: 小火摇动平底锅焙香碎黑胡椒，旁边放着细奶酪碎。
cacio-e-pepe.en: A hand shakes a pan of crushed black pepper over low heat beside a bowl of finely grated cheese.

cacio-e-pepe.zh: 小锅中搅拌变稠透明的淀粉糊，旁边放着奶酪碎。
cacio-e-pepe.en: A hand stirs thick, translucent starch gel in a small saucepan beside grated cheese.

cacio-e-pepe.zh: 手向沸水中的意面撒少许盐。
cacio-e-pepe.en: A hand adds a pinch of salt to spaghetti cooking in boiling water.

cacio-e-pepe.zh: 用叉子将奶酪和温面水搅成顺滑的糊。
cacio-e-pepe.en: A hand uses a fork to stir cheese and warm pasta water into a smooth paste.

cacio-e-pepe.zh: 中火用夹子翻拌意面和黑胡椒，锅底留少量汤汁。
cacio-e-pepe.en: Hands toss spaghetti and black pepper over medium heat with a little liquid left in the pan.

cacio-e-pepe.zh: 离火用夹子翻拌意面，奶酪酱均匀裹住面条。
cacio-e-pepe.en: Hands toss spaghetti off the heat until cheese sauce coats the strands.

cacio-e-pepe.zh: 手在装盘的黑胡椒奶酪意面上撒奶酪。
cacio-e-pepe.en: A hand sprinkles cheese over plated cacio e pepe.

cake-sale.zh: 用刷子在磅蛋糕模内涂抹黄油。
cake-sale.en: A hand brushes butter inside a loaf pan.

cake-sale.zh: 搅拌面粉和泡打粉，旁边放着火腿丁和奶酪丝。
cake-sale.en: A hand mixes flour and baking powder beside diced ham and shredded cheese.

cake-sale.zh: 一边将油倒入面糊，一边搅拌至没有干粉。
cake-sale.en: Oil is poured into the smooth batter as it is stirred.

cake-sale.zh: 将拌有火腿丁和奶酪丝的面糊倒入模具。
cake-sale.en: Ham and cheese batter is poured into the loaf pan.

cake-sale.zh: 用刀尖检查模具中金黄色蛋糕的中心。
cake-sale.en: A knife tip checks the center of the golden loaf in its pan.

cake-sale.zh: 将脱模的火腿奶酪咸蛋糕切片。
cake-sale.en: The unmolded ham and cheese loaf is sliced.

canh-chua-ca.zh: 用勺压滤罗望子果肉，汁流入碗中。
canh-chua-ca.en: A spoon presses tamarind pulp through a sieve into a bowl.

canh-chua-ca.zh: 切鱼块，菠萝、秋葵、番茄、豆芽和香草分碗放好。
canh-chua-ca.en: Fish is cut into chunks beside separate bowls of pineapple, okra, tomatoes, sprouts and herbs.

canh-chua-ca.zh: 锅中翻炒洋葱至软透，汤底调料放在一旁。
canh-chua-ca.en: Onions soften in a pot, with broth seasonings set alongside.

canh-chua-ca.zh: 汤中鱼块和菠萝微沸，用勺轻推鱼块。
canh-chua-ca.en: A spoon gently moves fish and pineapple in simmering broth.

canh-chua-ca.zh: 把秋葵段倒入鱼和菠萝的汤中。
canh-chua-ca.en: Okra pieces are added to the fish and pineapple soup.

canh-chua-ca.zh: 往鱼汤中倒入番茄、豆芽和切碎的香草。
canh-chua-ca.en: Tomatoes, bean sprouts and chopped herbs are added to the fish soup.

canh-chua-ca.zh: 往酸鱼汤上撒香菜，旁边放着白米饭。
canh-chua-ca.en: Cilantro is scattered over sour fish soup beside a bowl of rice.

canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.zh: 手在碗中搅匀蒜水、鱼露、糖和白胡椒。
canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.en: A hand stirs garlic water, fish sauce, sugar and white pepper in a bowl.

canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.zh: 手用厨房纸吸干腌过的生鸡翅，旁边锅里留着腌汁。
canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.en: A hand pats marinated raw wings dry beside a pan of reserved marinade.

canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.zh: 手给生鸡翅薄裹米粉，旁边深锅里的油正在加热。
canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.en: A hand lightly coats a raw wing in rice flour beside a pot of heating oil.

canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.zh: 手用漏勺翻动油中金黄的鸡翅，旁边放着沥油网架。
canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.en: A hand turns golden wings in oil with a slotted spoon beside a draining rack.

canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.zh: 手将蒜蓉辣椒酱倒入沸腾的腌汁中。
canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.en: A hand adds chili garlic sauce to vigorously boiling marinade.

canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.zh: 手在装盘的黏亮鱼露鸡翅上撒葱绿。
canh-ga-chien-nuoc-mam.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over plated, glossy fish sauce wings.

canh-kho-qua.zh: 用剪刀剪短泡软的粉丝，旁边放着木耳末。
canh-kho-qua.en: Hands snip soaked glass noodles into short pieces beside minced wood ear mushrooms.

canh-kho-qua.zh: 筷子沿一个方向搅拌，带起发黏成团的肉馅。
canh-kho-qua.en: Chopsticks stir in one direction and lift a sticky clump of pork filling.

canh-kho-qua.zh: 双手把肉馅压入中空的苦瓜筒。
canh-kho-qua.en: Hands press pork filling into a hollow bitter melon cylinder.

canh-kho-qua.zh: 用大匙将酿苦瓜轻放入沸腾的汤中，锅里还有肉丸。
canh-kho-qua.en: A spoon lowers stuffed bitter melon into boiling broth with meatballs.

canh-kho-qua.zh: 半盖的锅里汤面微冒泡，筷子试扎暗橄榄绿的苦瓜。
canh-kho-qua.en: Chopsticks test olive-green bitter melon in a partly covered pot of gently bubbling soup.

canh-kho-qua.zh: 用大匙把酿苦瓜盛入汤碗，旁边配白米饭。
canh-kho-qua.en: A spoon transfers stuffed bitter melon into a soup bowl beside white rice.

cantucci.zh: 手持打蛋器搅匀带茴芹籽的蛋液，旁边放着备用蛋液。
cantucci.en: A hand whisks the egg mixture with anise seeds beside a bowl of reserved beaten egg.

cantucci.zh: 用刮刀将杏仁和松子拌入柔软面团，旁边是备用蛋液。
cantucci.en: A spatula folds almonds and pine nuts into soft dough beside reserved beaten egg.

cantucci.zh: 在烤盘上间隔摆放的四条面团上薄刷蛋液。
cantucci.en: A hand brushes egg wash thinly over four spaced dough logs on a baking tray.

cantucci.zh: 戴烤箱手套的手取出四条浅金色饼条。
cantucci.en: An oven-mitted hand removes four pale golden baked logs from the oven.

cantucci.zh: 一手扶住饼条，另一手用锯齿刀斜切杏仁饼片。
cantucci.en: One hand steadies a baked log while the other cuts diagonal almond slices with a serrated knife.

cantucci.zh: 用铲子翻动烤盘上平铺的杏仁饼片。
cantucci.en: A hand turns an almond biscuit slice among slices laid flat on a baking tray.

cantucci.zh: 冷却架上放着杏仁脆饼，手将一片放入敞开的密闭盒。
cantucci.en: A hand places a cooled almond biscuit from the rack into an open airtight container.

caponata.zh: 用厨房纸擦干带皮茄子块的切面。
caponata.en: A hand pats the cut surfaces of skin-on eggplant cubes dry with kitchen paper.

caponata.zh: 切薄西芹，旁边备好洋葱、番茄、橄榄和酸豆。
caponata.en: A hand thinly slices celery beside prepared onion, tomato, olives, and capers.

caponata.zh: 小火翻炒番茄浓汁，锅里有洋葱、芹菜、橄榄、酸豆和松子。
caponata.en: A hand stirs reduced tomato sauce with onion, celery, olives, capers, and pine nuts over low heat.

caponata.zh: 用漏勺捞起油中炸至金黄的带皮茄子块。
caponata.en: A hand lifts a golden skin-on eggplant cube from bubbling oil with a slotted spoon.

caponata.zh: 大火轻翻茄子和浓汁，旁边备着醋和糖。
caponata.en: A hand gently folds eggplant into thick sauce over high heat, with vinegar and sugar nearby.

caponata.zh: 用勺轻翻浅盘里的茄子、橄榄和浓汁。
caponata.en: A hand gently folds eggplant, olives, and thick sauce together in a shallow dish.

carbonara.zh: 双手在案板上将腌猪颊肉切成条。
carbonara.en: Hands cut guanciale into strips on a board.

carbonara.zh: 用漏勺盛出金黄的腌猪颊肉，油留在锅里。
carbonara.en: A slotted spoon lifts golden guanciale from the pan, leaving the fat behind.

carbonara.zh: 用夹子从沸水中夹起一根意面。
carbonara.en: Tongs lift a strand of spaghetti from boiling water.

carbonara.zh: 在碗中搅拌蛋黄、奶酪和黑胡椒糊。
carbonara.en: A whisk mixes egg yolks, cheese and black pepper into a paste.

carbonara.zh: 在锅中翻拌意面，让面裹上油和煮面水。
carbonara.en: Spaghetti is tossed in a pan with rendered fat and pasta water.

carbonara.zh: 离火翻拌意面，金黄酱汁光滑地裹住面条。
carbonara.en: Off the heat, spaghetti is tossed until coated in a smooth golden sauce.

carbonara.zh: 在装盘的腌猪颊肉意面上撒奶酪和黑胡椒。
carbonara.en: Cheese and black pepper are sprinkled over plated guanciale pasta.

carottes-vichy.zh: 双手在案板上把胡萝卜切成薄圆片，旁边放着半圆片。
carottes-vichy.en: Hands slice a carrot into thin rounds on a board, with half-rounds alongside.

carottes-vichy.zh: 手往铺有胡萝卜片、黄油、糖和盐的浅锅里倒水。
carottes-vichy.en: A hand pours water into a shallow pan of carrot slices, butter, sugar, and salt.

carottes-vichy.zh: 手用细签试锅中轻轻沸腾的胡萝卜片，锅盖放在一旁。
carottes-vichy.en: A hand tests a gently simmering carrot slice with a skewer, with the lid set aside.

carottes-vichy.zh: 手在火上轻晃锅，胡萝卜片裹着亮汁，锅底冒着细泡。
carottes-vichy.en: A hand gently shakes the pan over heat as carrot slices glisten in a bubbling glaze.

carottes-vichy.zh: 双手把裹着亮汁和欧芹的胡萝卜片倒入红边白盘。
carottes-vichy.en: Hands tip glazed carrot slices and parsley onto a white plate with a red rim.

cassoulet.zh: 白豆、猪皮和香料在锅中大火沸煮。
cassoulet.en: White beans, pork skin and aromatics boil vigorously in a pot.

cassoulet.zh: 手将整块五花肉和蒜肠放入轻煮的豆锅。
cassoulet.en: A hand adds a whole piece of pork belly and garlic sausage to gently simmering beans.

cassoulet.zh: 手将豆汤舀入加了番茄和洋葱的羊肉锅。
cassoulet.en: A hand ladles bean broth into lamb with tomato and onion.

cassoulet.zh: 手用叉子拨开炖软的羊肉。
cassoulet.en: A hand pulls apart tender braised lamb with a fork.

cassoulet.zh: 手将白豆舀入铺有肉块和蒜肠的陶锅。
cassoulet.en: A hand spoons white beans into a casserole layered with meat and garlic sausage.

cassoulet.zh: 手沿烤箱中金褐色砂锅的锅边倒入豆汤。
cassoulet.en: A hand pours bean broth around the edge of the golden casserole in the oven.

cassoulet.zh: 金褐色的白豆肉锅放在锅垫上。
cassoulet.en: The golden bean and meat casserole rests on a trivet.

castagnole.zh: 用刮刀搅拌蛋、黄油和柠檬皮屑混合物，旁边放着混匀的粉类。
castagnole.en: A hand stirs the egg, butter and lemon zest mixture beside a bowl of mixed dry ingredients.

castagnole.zh: 双手在薄粉上轻轻合拢柔软的面团。
castagnole.en: Two hands gently bring soft dough together on a lightly floured surface.

castagnole.zh: 双手将分好的面团搓圆，旁边摆着面团粗条和小圆球。
castagnole.en: Two hands roll a portion of dough into a ball beside a dough rope and other small balls.

castagnole.zh: 用漏勺翻动油锅里的一只试炸球，油温计探头浸在油中。
castagnole.en: A hand turns one test ball in oil with a slotted spoon while a thermometer probe rests in the oil.

castagnole.zh: 用漏勺翻动油中金黄的炸球，旁边切开的试炸球内部松软多孔。
castagnole.en: A hand turns golden balls in oil beside a cut test ball with a soft, porous center.

castagnole.zh: 用手把金黄的炸球滚上白糖，旁边的炸球在吸油纸上沥油。
castagnole.en: A hand rolls golden fried balls in sugar beside others draining on absorbent paper.

cha-ca-la-vong.zh: 手将鱼块与黄色腌料拌匀。
cha-ca-la-vong.en: A hand mixes fish pieces until evenly coated in yellow marinade.

cha-ca-la-vong.zh: 手提漏盆沥干熟米线，旁边放着三个碗。
cha-ca-la-vong.en: A hand holds a colander of drained rice noodles beside three bowls.

cha-ca-la-vong.zh: 手搅拌带细泡的虾酱蘸汁。
cha-ca-la-vong.en: A hand stirs shrimp dipping sauce with fine bubbles on the surface.

cha-ca-la-vong.zh: 手从烤箱取出鱼块，鱼边变白，烤盘里留有汁水。
cha-ca-la-vong.en: A hand removes fish from the oven, with whitened edges and juices on the tray.

cha-ca-la-vong.zh: 手在锅中轻翻金黄鱼块、葱和翠绿莳萝。
cha-ca-la-vong.en: A hand gently turns golden fish, scallions and green dill in a pan.

cha-ca-la-vong.zh: 手往鱼、葱和莳萝米线上撒花生，旁边放着蘸汁。
cha-ca-la-vong.en: A hand sprinkles peanuts over fish, scallions and dill on rice noodles, with dipping sauce alongside.

cha-gio.zh: 双手用剪刀剪短粉丝，旁边放着木耳丝。
cha-gio.en: Hands cut glass noodles with scissors beside a bowl of shredded wood ear mushrooms.

cha-gio.zh: 双手用勺拌匀猪肉、虾、蔬菜和粉丝馅。
cha-gio.en: Hands stir pork, shrimp, vegetables and glass noodles into a cohesive filling.

cha-gio.zh: 双手用湿布擦拭一张柔软的米纸。
cha-gio.en: Hands wipe one pliable rice paper sheet with a damp cloth.

cha-gio.zh: 双手将米纸两侧向馅料中间折入。
cha-gio.en: Hands fold both sides of the rice paper inward over the filling.

cha-gio.zh: 春卷在中火油锅里冒泡，手用筷子轻翻。
cha-gio.en: A hand gently turns spring rolls bubbling in oil over medium heat.

cha-gio.zh: 手用漏勺将金黄春卷放到网架上沥油。
cha-gio.en: A hand places a golden spring roll on a wire rack to drain.

cha-trung-hap.zh: 用剪刀剪短泡软的粉丝，旁边放着红葱头和香菜碎。
cha-trung-hap.en: Scissors cut softened glass noodles beside minced shallot and cilantro.

cha-trung-hap.zh: 用叉子将粉丝、猪肉末、红葱头和香菜拌匀。
cha-trung-hap.en: A fork mixes glass noodles, ground pork, shallot, and cilantro.

cha-trung-hap.zh: 将拌匀的蛋肉粉丝馅倒入耐热浅盘。
cha-trung-hap.en: The mixed egg, pork, and noodles are poured into a shallow heatproof dish.

cha-trung-hap.zh: 将松盖铝箔的浅盘放上沸水锅中的蒸架。
cha-trung-hap.en: A loosely foil-covered dish is lowered onto a rack over boiling water.

cha-trung-hap.zh: 掀开铝箔，将温度计探针插入凝固的蛋肉饼中心。
cha-trung-hap.en: A thermometer probe is inserted into the center of the set egg and pork cake.

cha-trung-hap.zh: 用宽铲托起切好的蒸蛋肉饼，准备装盘。
cha-trung-hap.en: A wide spatula lifts a cut wedge of steamed egg and pork cake onto a plate.

cha-ye-dan.zh: 八个完整鸡蛋在清水中小沸。
cha-ye-dan.en: Eight whole eggs gently simmer in clear water.

cha-ye-dan.zh: 用勺背轻敲冷水中的鸡蛋，蛋壳布满细裂纹。
cha-ye-dan.en: A spoon gently taps an egg in cold water, leaving fine cracks in its shell.

cha-ye-dan.zh: 往盛有裂壳鸡蛋和香料的卤汁中倒入红茶。
cha-ye-dan.en: Black tea leaves are poured into broth with cracked eggs and spices.

cha-ye-dan.zh: 小火轻煮卤汁中的裂壳鸡蛋，用勺轻轻翻动。
cha-ye-dan.en: A spoon gently turns cracked eggs in lightly simmering spiced broth.

cha-ye-dan.zh: 鸡蛋和滤好的卤汁分装在浅碗中，浸在冷水里降温。
cha-ye-dan.en: Eggs and strained broth cool in separate shallow bowls set in cold water.

cha-ye-dan.zh: 剥开茶叶蛋，露出蛋白上的褐色纹路。
cha-ye-dan.en: A tea egg is peeled to reveal brown marbling on the white.

cha-yen.zh: 手持勺子轻搅壶中深红褐色茶汤，茶叶全部浸湿。
cha-yen.en: A hand gently stirs fully wetted tea leaves in a pitcher of deep reddish-brown tea.

cha-yen.zh: 茶汤经过滤网滴入壶中，茶叶留在滤网里。
cha-yen.en: Tea drips through a strainer into a pitcher, leaving the leaves in the mesh.

cha-yen.zh: 手搅拌壶中的红褐色茶汤，旁边放着糖和盐。
cha-yen.en: A hand stirs reddish-brown tea in a pitcher beside bowls of sugar and salt.

cha-yen.zh: 手搅拌杯中颜色均匀的橙色奶茶，旁边有炼乳。
cha-yen.en: A hand stirs a glass of evenly orange milk tea beside a bowl of condensed milk.

cha-yen.zh: 手将淡奶淋在冰奶茶上，淡奶沿冰块形成浅色纹路。
cha-yen.en: A hand pours evaporated milk over iced tea, leaving pale ribbons around the ice.

chang-fen.zh: 手持打蛋器搅匀白色粉浆，旁边放着香菇片。
chang-fen.en: A hand whisks smooth white batter beside a bowl of sliced shiitake.

chang-fen.zh: 双手将豉油汁倒过筛网，滤去洋葱、蒜和香菇。
chang-fen.en: Hands strain soy sauce through a sieve, retaining onion, garlic and shiitake.

chang-fen.zh: 蒸锅中的水大火沸腾，浅盘架在水面上。
chang-fen.en: Water boils vigorously beneath an elevated shallow tray in a steamer.

chang-fen.zh: 手把虾仁沿刚定形的米皮一侧排放。
chang-fen.en: A hand arranges shrimp along one side of the just-set rice sheet.

chang-fen.zh: 手用夹子取出蒸盘，米皮起小泡，虾仁变得不透明。
chang-fen.en: A hand holds the steaming tray with tongs; the rice sheet is bubbled and the shrimp are opaque.

chang-fen.zh: 手将豉油汁淋在盘中的鲜虾肠粉上。
chang-fen.en: A hand pours soy sauce over plated shrimp rice noodle rolls.

chao-ga.zh: 手将鱼露倒入姜末蘸汁并搅拌。
chao-ga.en: A hand pours fish sauce into the minced ginger dipping sauce while stirring.

chao-ga.zh: 手在微浑的水中淘米，旁边放着葱和香菜。
chao-ga.en: A hand washes rice in slightly cloudy water beside prepared scallions and cilantro.

chao-ga.zh: 半盖锅中鸡腿、米、姜片和葱白在大火上沸腾。
chao-ga.en: Chicken legs, rice, ginger and scallion whites boil over high heat in a partially covered pot.

chao-ga.zh: 用夹子从微沸的米汤中捞出熟鸡腿。
chao-ga.en: Tongs lift a cooked chicken leg from gently simmering rice broth.

chao-ga.zh: 用木勺搅动半盖锅里乳白浓稠的米粥。
chao-ga.en: A wooden spoon stirs thick milky congee in a partially covered pot.

chao-ga.zh: 手将带皮熟鸡肉切块，旁边放着鸡肉和蘸汁。
chao-ga.en: Hands slice cooked skin-on chicken beside a plate of chicken and dipping sauce.

chao-ga.zh: 手往鸡粥上撒葱花，旁边配鸡肉和姜汁。
chao-ga.en: A hand scatters scallions over congee served with chicken and ginger dipping sauce.

chao-he-fen.zh: 双手在案板上轻轻拆散宽河粉。
chao-he-fen.en: Two hands gently separate wide rice noodles over a board.

chao-he-fen.zh: 用漏勺捞出豆芽沥水，旁边放着黄瓜丝和面筋块。
chao-he-fen.en: A skimmer lifts bean sprouts to drain beside bowls of cucumber strips and wheat gluten cubes.

chao-he-fen.zh: 用筷子拌匀裹薄浆的肉丝，旁边放着蛋液。
chao-he-fen.en: Chopsticks mix thinly coated pork strips beside a bowl of beaten egg.

chao-he-fen.zh: 锅铲翻动凝固的鸡蛋，炒熟的肉丝放在旁边。
chao-he-fen.en: A spatula turns set scrambled eggs beside a bowl of cooked pork strips.

chao-he-fen.zh: 向炒至褐色均匀的河粉撒入孜然粉。
chao-he-fen.en: Cumin is sprinkled over evenly browned rice noodles in the wok.

chao-he-fen.zh: 往锅里倒生抽，用锅铲托起河粉和配料翻拌。
chao-he-fen.en: Light soy sauce is poured into the wok as a spatula lifts the noodles and other ingredients.

chao-he-fen.zh: 用锅铲将炒好的河粉和配料盛入盘中。
chao-he-fen.en: A spatula transfers the cooked noodles and their accompaniments onto a plate.

chao-hua-dan.zh: 用打蛋器搅拌碗中均匀的蛋液。
chao-hua-dan.en: Whisk the evenly blended egg mixture in a bowl.

chao-hua-dan.zh: 倾斜平底锅，让油在中火上铺开。
chao-hua-dan.en: Tilt the frying pan over medium heat to spread the oil.

chao-hua-dan.zh: 小火下用铲子把锅边初凝的蛋推向中央。
chao-hua-dan.en: Over low heat, push the just-set egg from the edge toward the center.

chao-hua-dan.zh: 小火下用铲子轻轻折叠大块软蛋。
chao-hua-dan.en: Gently fold the large soft egg curds with a spatula over low heat.

chao-hua-dan.zh: 在盘中的滑蛋上撒盐和黑胡椒碎。
chao-hua-dan.en: Sprinkle salt and crushed black pepper over the plated eggs.

chao-liang-fen.zh: 手将凉粉方块放入盘中，旁边备好蒜末、葱花和豆瓣酱。
chao-liang-fen.en: A hand places jelly cubes on a plate beside minced garlic, scallions, and doubanjiang.

chao-liang-fen.zh: 小火翻炒蒜末和豆瓣酱，锅中红油冒着细泡。
chao-liang-fen.en: Garlic and doubanjiang are stirred over low heat in gently bubbling red oil.

chao-liang-fen.zh: 锅铲从底部托起沾了红油和豆瓣的凉粉块。
chao-liang-fen.en: A spatula lifts jelly cubes coated with red oil and doubanjiang from the pan.

chao-liang-fen.zh: 手把香料粉撒在湿润的凉粉和红色酱汁上。
chao-liang-fen.en: A hand sprinkles ground spice onto the moist jelly cubes and red sauce.

chao-liang-fen.zh: 凉粉在盖着锅盖的平底锅里用小火焖煮。
chao-liang-fen.en: The jelly cubes simmer in a covered frying pan over low heat.

chao-liang-fen.zh: 筷子夹起一块凉粉，锅底留着湿润的酱汁。
chao-liang-fen.en: Chopsticks lift a jelly cube above the moist sauce remaining in the pan.

chao-liang-fen.zh: 手在装盘的酱汁凉粉上撒葱花。
chao-liang-fen.en: A hand scatters chopped scallions over the plated sauced jelly cubes.

chao-mo.zh: 手把馒头切成小丁，旁边放着葱花。
chao-mo.en: Hands cut a steamed bun into small cubes beside a bowl of chopped scallions.

chao-mo.zh: 手将蛋液倒在馍丁上，轻轻拌匀。
chao-mo.en: Hands pour beaten egg onto the bun cubes and gently mix them.

chao-mo.zh: 手将裹蛋液的馍丁倒入油锅，摊开定形。
chao-mo.en: Hands tip egg-coated bun cubes into an oiled wok and spread them out to set.

chao-mo.zh: 手用锅铲翻动锅中分开的金黄馍丁。
chao-mo.en: Hands turn separate golden bun cubes in the wok with a spatula.

chao-mo.zh: 手在锅中炒熟余下的蛋液，金黄馍丁盛在一旁。
chao-mo.en: Hands scramble the remaining egg until set while golden bun cubes wait in a bowl.

chao-mo.zh: 手将调味粉撒在锅中的金黄馍丁和熟鸡蛋上。
chao-mo.en: A hand sprinkles seasoning over golden bun cubes and cooked egg in the wok.

chao-mo.zh: 手将金黄馍丁、鸡蛋和葱花摊在浅盘中。
chao-mo.en: Hands spread golden bun cubes, egg and scallions on a shallow plate.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 锅中煮着年糕，勺子托起弯曲的软年糕片。
chao-nian-gao.en: A spoon lifts a flexible rice cake slice from simmering water.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 将泡在水里的年糕倒入漏勺沥干。
chao-nian-gao.en: Rice cakes and water are poured into a colander to drain.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 切小白菜，旁边备有葱段和打散的鸡蛋。
chao-nian-gao.en: Bok choy is being cut beside scallion segments and beaten egg.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 将浅金黄的葱白连同葱油舀出。
chao-nian-gao.en: Pale golden scallion whites and their oil are spooned out of the wok.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 用锅铲轻推刚凝固的鸡蛋成块。
chao-nian-gao.en: A spatula gently pushes just-set egg into curds in the wok.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 锅铲轻翻年糕和炒软的小白菜。
chao-nian-gao.en: A spatula gently folds rice cakes with softened bok choy in the wok.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 将鸡蛋倒回锅中，年糕已均匀上色。
chao-nian-gao.en: Egg curds are returned to the wok with evenly coated rice cakes and bok choy.

chao-nian-gao.zh: 将拌好葱段、鸡蛋和小白菜的炒年糕盛入盘中。
chao-nian-gao.en: The finished rice cakes with scallions, egg and bok choy are served onto a plate.

chao-qie-zi.zh: 手持刀切茄子，旁边备好葱花、八角、糖和醋。
chao-qie-zi.en: A hand cuts eggplant beside prepared scallions, star anise, sugar and vinegar.

chao-qie-zi.zh: 锅铲翻炒已变色的猪肉末。
chao-qie-zi.en: A spatula stirs pork mince that has changed color in the wok.

chao-qie-zi.zh: 将茄块倒入盛有葱花、八角和虾皮的油锅。
chao-qie-zi.en: Eggplant pieces are tipped into a wok with scallions, star anise and dried shrimp.

chao-qie-zi.zh: 向锅里的茄块淋入生抽。
chao-qie-zi.en: Soy sauce is poured over the eggplant in the wok.

chao-qie-zi.zh: 将熟猪肉末倒回盛有茄块的锅中。
chao-qie-zi.en: Cooked pork mince is returned to the wok of eggplant.

chao-qie-zi.zh: 用锅铲将炒茄子和肉末盛入盘中。
chao-qie-zi.en: A spatula transfers cooked eggplant and pork mince onto a plate.

chao-qing-cai.zh: 菜刀沿小白菜的粗梗纵向切开，旁边放着蒜末。
chao-qing-cai.en: A knife splits a thick bok choy stalk lengthwise beside minced garlic.

chao-qing-cai.zh: 转动热锅，让油铺开锅底。
chao-qing-cai.en: The hot wok is tilted to spread oil across the bottom.

chao-qing-cai.zh: 用锅铲抄底翻炒小白菜，叶片开始变软。
chao-qing-cai.en: A spatula lifts and turns bok choy as its leaves begin to soften.

chao-qing-cai.zh: 向有蒜末的青菜锅里加水，锅底的水正在沸腾。
chao-qing-cai.en: Water is poured into the bok choy and garlic, bubbling at the bottom.

chao-qing-cai.zh: 向小火上的青菜撒糖，锅盖放在一旁。
chao-qing-cai.en: Sugar is sprinkled onto the bok choy over low heat, with a lid nearby.

chao-qing-cai.zh: 用锅铲将炒好的青菜盛入红边盘中。
chao-qing-cai.en: Cooked bok choy is transferred to a red-rimmed plate with a spatula.

chao-tang-se.zh: 锅中水正沸腾，旁边备着一壶热水和长柄勺。
chao-tang-se.en: Water boils in a saucepan beside a jug of hot water and a long-handled spoon.

chao-tang-se.zh: 手持长柄勺搅拌锅中清亮的糖水和油。
chao-tang-se.en: A hand stirs clear sugar water and oil in a saucepan with a long-handled spoon.

chao-tang-se.zh: 手轻转锅柄，锅内淡黄色糖液冒着许多泡。
chao-tang-se.en: A hand gently swirls the pan as pale golden syrup bubbles.

chao-tang-se.zh: 手将锅端离灶台，锅中糖液呈红褐色。
chao-tang-se.en: A hand lifts the pan off the stove with reddish-brown caramel inside.

chao-tang-se.zh: 手沿离火锅边缓缓倒入热水，糖液剧烈起泡。
chao-tang-se.en: A hand slowly pours hot water along the edge of the pan off the heat as caramel bubbles vigorously.

chao-tang-se.zh: 手在小火上轻搅红褐色糖液，表面有油滴和气泡。
chao-tang-se.en: A hand gently stirs reddish-brown caramel over low heat, with oil droplets and bubbles on the surface.

chawanmushi.zh: 手正把香菇切片，旁边摆着鸡肉、虾、菠菜和腌汁。
chawanmushi.en: A hand slices shiitake beside prepared chicken, shrimp, spinach and marinade.

chawanmushi.zh: 手将虾放入小杯，杯底松铺着鸡肉和香菇。
chawanmushi.en: A hand places a shrimp in a cup over loosely arranged chicken and shiitake.

chawanmushi.zh: 手将出汁缓缓倒入蛋液，同时用筷子轻搅。
chawanmushi.en: Hands slowly pour dashi into beaten egg and gently stir with chopsticks.

chawanmushi.zh: 手将蛋液过筛倒入小杯，旁边的杯底盛着配料。
chawanmushi.en: A hand strains egg mixture into a cup beside cups holding the fillings.

chawanmushi.zh: 四个加盖小杯间隔放在蒸锅里，小火下蒸汽缓缓升起。
chawanmushi.en: Four covered cups sit spaced apart in a steamer over a small flame as steam rises.

chawanmushi.zh: 手将细探针插入蛋羹中心，杯盖放在一旁。
chawanmushi.en: A hand inserts a thin probe into the center of the custard, with the lid beside the cup.

che-chuoi.zh: 双手在案板上将去皮香蕉斜切成厚片。
che-chuoi.en: Hands cut a peeled banana diagonally into thick slices on a cutting board.

che-chuoi.zh: 小锅中的椰奶和西米微微冒泡，手持勺搅拌。
che-chuoi.en: A hand stirs tapioca pearls in gently bubbling coconut milk over heat.

che-chuoi.zh: 小锅离火放在垫上，揭起锅盖露出膨胀的西米。
che-chuoi.en: A hand lifts the lid of the saucepan on a trivet, revealing swollen tapioca pearls.

che-chuoi.zh: 小火下用勺轻推椰奶中的香蕉片和透明西米。
che-chuoi.en: A hand gently stirs banana slices and translucent tapioca pearls in coconut milk over low heat.

che-chuoi.zh: 手将花生碎和芝麻撒在四碗香蕉椰奶西米上。
che-chuoi.en: A hand sprinkles chopped peanuts and sesame over four bowls of banana coconut tapioca.

chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.zh: 手扶滤盆，沥干泡胀的红豆。
chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.en: A hand holds a colander as swollen soaked adzuki beans drain.

chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.zh: 双手用刀将泡软的陈皮切成细丝。
chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.en: Hands cut softened tangerine peel into thin strips.

chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.zh: 红豆和陈皮在锅中沸腾，手用勺撇去浮沫。
chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.en: A hand skims foam from boiling adzuki beans and tangerine peel.

chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.zh: 红豆在锅中轻煮，手指将一粒软豆压散。
chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.en: A hand presses a softened bean apart while the beans simmer gently.

chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.zh: 手用汤勺背将软豆压在锅壁上，豆沙逐渐变细。
chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.en: A hand presses soft beans against the pot with the back of a ladle.

chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.zh: 手用汤勺将可流动的陈皮红豆沙盛入小碗。
chen-pi-hong-dou-sha.en: A hand ladles flowing red bean soup with tangerine peel into a small bowl.

chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.zh: 手用漏勺从浮沫集中的锅中捞起变色排骨。
chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.en: A hand lifts a pale rib from the scum-topped water with a slotted spoon.

chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.zh: 双手在水流下冲洗筛中的陈皮和干货。
chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.en: Hands rinse tangerine peel and dried ingredients in a sieve under running water.

chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.zh: 手向装有排骨、陈皮和干货的炖盅注水。
chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.en: A hand pours water into the crock containing ribs, tangerine peel and dried ingredients.

chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.zh: 手向放有带盖炖盅和蒸架的外锅加水。
chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.en: A hand pours water into the outer pot around a covered crock on a rack.

chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.zh: 炖盅在外锅中隔水受热，锅底燃着小火。
chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.en: A covered crock heats in gently simmering water over a low flame.

chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.zh: 手用筷子插入汤中最厚的一块排骨。
chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.en: A hand probes the thickest rib in the soup with chopsticks.

chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.zh: 手向陈皮排骨汤中撒入少量盐。
chen-pi-pai-gu-tang.en: A hand sprinkles a little salt into the tangerine peel and pork rib soup.

cheng-bao-dan.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞起张开的蛏子。
cheng-bao-dan.en: A slotted spoon lifts an opened razor clam from boiling water.

cheng-bao-dan.zh: 用厨房纸轻吸筛网中完整蛏肉的水分。
cheng-bao-dan.en: A hand gently blots whole razor clam meat in a sieve.

cheng-bao-dan.zh: 搅拌包裹蛏肉和洋葱丁的均匀蛋糊。
cheng-bao-dan.en: A hand stirs whole razor clam meat and diced onion into an even egg batter.

cheng-bao-dan.zh: 将蛏肉蛋糊倒入热油锅中，摊成薄层。
cheng-bao-dan.en: Razor clam batter is poured into hot oil and spread thinly in a pan.

cheng-bao-dan.zh: 用宽铲翻起边缘金黄、已经定形的蛋片。
cheng-bao-dan.en: A wide spatula turns a set piece of omelette with golden edges.

cheng-bao-dan.zh: 将探针插入锅中金黄蛋饼的中心。
cheng-bao-dan.en: A probe is inserted into the center of the golden omelette in the pan.

cheng-bao-dan.zh: 用漏铲将切块的金黄蛏抱蛋放上红边盘。
cheng-bao-dan.en: A slotted spatula places the cut golden razor clam omelette on a red-rimmed plate.

chi-you-ji.zh: 用长柄勺把沸水浇在深盘里的整鸡上。
chi-you-ji.en: A hand pours boiling water over a whole chicken in a deep dish.

chi-you-ji.zh: 用锅铲翻炒姜片、红葱头、八角和葱段。
chi-you-ji.en: A hand stirs ginger, shallots, star anise and scallions in oil.

chi-you-ji.zh: 把米酒倒入锅边冒小泡的深色卤汁。
chi-you-ji.en: A hand pours rice wine into dark braising liquid bubbling at the edges.

chi-you-ji.zh: 用勺把卤汁浇在半浸于锅中的整鸡上。
chi-you-ji.en: A hand ladles braising liquid over a whole chicken partly submerged in the pot.

chi-you-ji.zh: 把探针插入锅中棕色整鸡的腿根测温。
chi-you-ji.en: A hand inserts a temperature probe into the thigh of the brown chicken in the pot.

chi-you-ji.zh: 棕色整鸡放在两袋密封冰块之间冷却。
chi-you-ji.en: A whole brown chicken cools between two sealed bags of ice.

chi-you-ji.zh: 边搅拌棕色汁液，边倒入白色淀粉水。
chi-you-ji.en: One hand stirs brown sauce while another pours in white cornstarch slurry.

chi-you-ji.zh: 用勺把棕色薄汁淋在盘中的带皮鸡块上。
chi-you-ji.en: A hand spoons brown sauce over skin-on chicken pieces on a platter.

chi-zhi-pai-gu.zh: 用厨房纸吸干碗中生排骨表面的水分。
chi-zhi-pai-gu.en: A hand pats drained raw ribs dry with kitchen paper.

chi-zhi-pai-gu.zh: 案板上剁豆豉，旁边放着蒜蓉、姜末和葱花。
chi-zhi-pai-gu.en: Hands chop fermented black beans beside minced garlic, ginger and scallions.

chi-zhi-pai-gu.zh: 用手抓拌排骨，肉块裹着豆豉蒜姜和薄浆。
chi-zhi-pai-gu.en: A hand mixes ribs with black beans, garlic and ginger in a thin coating.

chi-zhi-pai-gu.zh: 将腌好的排骨间隔着单层摆入浅盘。
chi-zhi-pai-gu.en: A hand spaces marinated ribs in a single layer on a shallow plate.

chi-zhi-pai-gu.zh: 蒸锅中排骨盘冒着蒸汽，手正盖上锅盖。
chi-zhi-pai-gu.en: A hand lowers the lid over a steaming plate of ribs in the steamer.

chi-zhi-pai-gu.zh: 将探针插入最大一块熟排骨的肉中测温。
chi-zhi-pai-gu.en: A hand inserts a thermometer probe into the meat of the largest cooked rib.

chi-zhi-pai-gu.zh: 在豉汁排骨上撒葱花，盘中留着蒸汁。
chi-zhi-pai-gu.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over black bean ribs in their steaming juices.

chicken-nanban.zh: 双手在案板上切碎蛋黄凝固的熟鸡蛋。
chicken-nanban.en: Hands chop a fully cooked egg on a cutting board.

chicken-nanban.zh: 手用勺拌匀含熟蛋、黄瓜和洋葱的塔塔酱。
chicken-nanban.en: A hand stirs tartar sauce with cooked egg, cucumber and onion.

chicken-nanban.zh: 手搅拌小锅中的南蛮醋，锅边轻轻冒泡。
chicken-nanban.en: A hand stirs nanban sauce as small bubbles form at the edge of the saucepan.

chicken-nanban.zh: 手抖掉鸡胸片上的余粉，旁边放着蛋液。
chicken-nanban.en: A hand shakes excess flour from a chicken cutlet beside a bowl of beaten egg.

chicken-nanban.zh: 手用夹子翻动油锅中炸至浅金黄的鸡胸片。
chicken-nanban.en: A hand turns a pale golden chicken cutlet in a pot of hot oil.

chicken-nanban.zh: 手用夹子将整片金黄鸡肉浸入南蛮醋。
chicken-nanban.en: A hand uses tongs to dip a whole golden chicken cutlet in nanban sauce.

chicken-nanban.zh: 手将塔塔酱舀在切好的鸡肉上，盘边有卷心菜和番茄。
chicken-nanban.en: A hand spoons tartar sauce onto sliced chicken beside cabbage and tomatoes.

chicken-teriyaki.zh: 用叉子在展开的鸡腿皮上扎浅孔。
chicken-teriyaki.en: A hand pricks shallow holes in the skin of flattened chicken legs with a fork.

chicken-teriyaki.zh: 搅拌碗中的照烧汁，旁边放着干净的盘子。
chicken-teriyaki.en: A hand stirs teriyaki sauce in a bowl beside a clean plate.

chicken-teriyaki.zh: 鸡腿皮朝下煎至边缘金黄，铲子轻压鸡肉。
chicken-teriyaki.en: A spatula presses chicken skin-side down as its edges turn golden in the pan.

chicken-teriyaki.zh: 用探针从侧面测量锅中鸡腿最厚处。
chicken-teriyaki.en: A hand inserts a probe into the thickest part of a chicken leg in the pan.

chicken-teriyaki.zh: 锅中照烧汁冒出密集气泡，木铲刮起锅底肉汁。
chicken-teriyaki.en: A wooden spatula scrapes browned pan juices into densely bubbling teriyaki sauce.

chicken-teriyaki.zh: 用勺子把酱汁淋在装盘的鸡腿切片上。
chicken-teriyaki.en: A hand spoons sauce over sliced chicken teriyaki on a plate.

chikuzenni.zh: 搅拌裹满腌汁的鸡块，旁边放着香菇和泡发水。
chikuzenni.en: A hand stirs marinated chicken beside shiitake and soaking liquid.

chikuzenni.zh: 手把藕片放入水中，另一碗浸泡着牛蒡片。
chikuzenni.en: A hand places lotus root in water beside a bowl of soaking burdock.

chikuzenni.zh: 手冲洗芋头块，旁边摆着切好的竹笋、胡萝卜、蒟蒻和荷兰豆。
chikuzenni.en: A hand rinses taro beside prepared bamboo shoots, carrots, konnyaku and snow peas.

chikuzenni.zh: 手从沸水中捞出鲜绿的荷兰豆，旁边放着蒟蒻。
chikuzenni.en: A hand lifts bright green snow peas from boiling water beside a bowl of konnyaku.

chikuzenni.zh: 手翻炒油亮的根菜、香菇和蒟蒻，旁边放着炒过的鸡肉。
chikuzenni.en: A hand stir-fries glossy roots, shiitake and konnyaku beside cooked chicken.

chikuzenni.zh: 鸡肉倒入盛着根菜和煮汁的锅中，锅边冒着小泡。
chikuzenni.en: Chicken is added to a pan of roots and broth bubbling at the edges.

chikuzenni.zh: 手用竹签试芋头的软硬，锅底留有煮汁，落盖放在一旁。
chikuzenni.en: A hand tests taro with a skewer in a pan with broth and a drop lid beside it.

chikuzenni.zh: 手把荷兰豆放在盛有鸡肉和根菜的盘中。
chikuzenni.en: A hand places a snow pea on a platter of chicken and simmered vegetables.

chong-qing-la-zi-ji.zh: 用筷子从腌好的带骨鸡块中挑出姜片和葱段。
chong-qing-la-zi-ji.en: Chopsticks remove ginger and scallion from marinated bone-in chicken pieces.

chong-qing-la-zi-ji.zh: 将辣椒段铺开检查水分，旁边备有姜片、蒜片和葱花。
chong-qing-la-zi-ji.en: A hand checks spread-out chili pieces beside sliced ginger, garlic and scallions.

chong-qing-la-zi-ji.zh: 用漏勺从油锅中捞起初炸至浅金黄的带骨鸡块。
chong-qing-la-zi-ji.en: A skimmer lifts a pale golden bone-in chicken piece from the frying oil.

chong-qing-la-zi-ji.zh: 用漏勺将复炸至金黄的鸡块摊到漏网上沥油。
chong-qing-la-zi-ji.en: A skimmer transfers golden twice-fried chicken pieces to a draining rack.

chong-qing-la-zi-ji.zh: 小火翻炒红亮的辣椒段、花椒、姜片和蒜片。
chong-qing-la-zi-ji.en: Chilies, Sichuan peppercorns, ginger and garlic are tossed in a wok over a low flame.

chong-qing-la-zi-ji.zh: 将拌匀芝麻和葱花的辣子鸡从炒锅倒入盘中。
chong-qing-la-zi-ji.en: Chongqing chicken with sesame and scallions is tipped from the wok onto a plate.

chukadon.zh: 双手撕开泡发的木耳，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜。
chukadon.en: Hands tear soaked wood ear mushrooms beside prepared vegetables.

chukadon.zh: 用筷子拌匀猪肉和虾仁，旁边放着淀粉水。
chukadon.en: Chopsticks mix pork and shrimp beside a bowl of starch slurry.

chukadon.zh: 大火炒开猪肉和虾仁，肉片发白、虾身变粉。
chukadon.en: Pork turns white and shrimp pink as they fry over high heat.

chukadon.zh: 把菜叶和香菇倒入锅中，与木耳和蔬菜同炒。
chukadon.en: Leafy greens and shiitake are added to the frying vegetables and wood ear.

chukadon.zh: 白菜、胡萝卜等蔬菜在锅中沸煮。
chukadon.en: Napa cabbage, carrots and other vegetables simmer in broth.

chukadon.zh: 向肉虾和蔬菜的汤中倒入深色调味汁。
chukadon.en: Dark seasoning sauce is poured into simmering pork, shrimp and vegetables.

chukadon.zh: 将淀粉水淋入微沸的肉虾蔬菜汤中并轻推。
chukadon.en: Starch slurry is poured into gently simmering pork, shrimp and vegetables while stirring.

chukadon.zh: 将肉虾、蔬菜和芡汁舀到两碗米饭上。
chukadon.en: Pork, shrimp, vegetables and sauce are ladled over two bowls of rice.

chun-bing.zh: 一手倒沸水，一手用筷子将面粉搅成软面团。
chun-bing.en: One hand pours boiling water while the other stirs flour into soft dough with chopsticks.

chun-bing.zh: 双手在薄撒面粉的案板上揉匀面团。
chun-bing.en: Hands knead the dough on a lightly floured board.

chun-bing.zh: 双手拉起醒好的柔软面团，旁边放着盖布。
chun-bing.en: Hands stretch the soft rested dough beside a folded cloth.

chun-bing.zh: 用刷子给一片小面剂刷油，另一片放在旁边。
chun-bing.en: A brush coats one small dough disc with oil beside a second disc.

chun-bing.zh: 双手用擀面杖将叠面擀成薄圆片。
chun-bing.en: Hands roll the paired dough into a thin round.

chun-bing.zh: 平底锅里的叠饼鼓起小泡，底面出现浅褐斑。
chun-bing.en: A paired pancake bubbles in a skillet, with light brown spots underneath.

chun-bing.zh: 双手从边缘揭开烙熟的两层薄饼。
chun-bing.en: Hands peel two cooked pancakes apart from the edge.

chun-bing.zh: 双手向上折起春饼底边，饼中放着少量合菜。
chun-bing.en: Hands fold up the bottom edge of a pancake around a small amount of vegetables and egg.

clafoutis.zh: 手在烤盘内刷黄油，旁边放着去核樱桃和樱桃汁。
clafoutis.en: A hand brushes butter inside the baking dish beside pitted cherries and reserved juice.

clafoutis.zh: 手将稀面糊倒过细筛，流入碗中。
clafoutis.en: A hand pours thin batter through a fine sieve into a bowl.

clafoutis.zh: 戴着烤箱手套的手从烤箱取出表面浅色的面糊薄底。
clafoutis.en: An oven-mitted hand removes the pale, thin batter base from the oven.

clafoutis.zh: 手向铺匀樱桃和糖的烤盘中倒入稀面糊。
clafoutis.en: A hand pours thin batter over evenly spread cherries and sugar in the baking dish.

clafoutis.zh: 手用细签检查边缘金黄、樱桃均匀分布的克拉芙缇中心。
clafoutis.en: A hand tests the center of the golden-edged cherry clafoutis with a skewer.

clafoutis.zh: 手将边缘金黄的樱桃克拉芙缇切成块。
clafoutis.en: A hand cuts a wedge of golden-edged cherry clafoutis.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 用漏勺撇去沸腾鸡汤表面的浮沫，锅里有鸡块、姜和葱。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: A skimmer removes foam from boiling broth with chicken, ginger, and scallions.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 用温度探针测量鸡汤中鸡胸最厚处。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: A temperature probe checks the thickest part of a chicken breast in broth.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 把熟鸡块放进加了冰块的冷水中。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: A cooked chicken piece is lowered into a bowl of ice water.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 锅中翻炒裹油和姜黄的淡黄色米粒。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: Rice coated in oil and turmeric is stirred in a pot.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 锅中黄米表面露出小孔，汤汁降到米面。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: Small holes appear across the yellow rice as the broth reaches its surface.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 往浸着洋葱薄片的冰水中倒入青柠汁。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: Lime juice is poured into ice water containing thin onion slices.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 将拌有洋葱和越南香菜的鸡丝夹到黄饭旁，辣椒另放。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: Shredded chicken with onion and Vietnamese coriander is placed beside yellow rice, with chilies served separately.

com-ga-hoi-an.zh: 把鸡汤舀进小碗，与鸡饭和辣椒一起上桌。
com-ga-hoi-an.en: Chicken broth is ladled into a small bowl beside chicken rice and chilies.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 双手将香茅蒜腌料抹在带骨猪排上。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: Hands rub lemongrass and garlic marinade over bone-in pork chops.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 手将腌汁倒入装有萝卜和胡萝卜细条的罐中。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: A hand pours pickling liquid into a jar of daikon and carrot strips.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 手用饭勺拨松电饭锅里煮熟的碎米。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: A hand fluffs cooked broken rice in a rice cooker with a paddle.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 手用黄瓜片蘸有蒜末和辣椒的鱼露汁。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: A hand dips a cucumber slice into fish sauce dressing with garlic and chili.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 手用夹子将四块生猪排摊在烤架上。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: A hand uses tongs to spread four raw pork chops on the grill.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 手从侧面测量烤出深褐纹路的猪排。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: A hand probes the side of a pork chop with deep brown grill marks.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 手搅动小锅里轻轻冒泡的葱油。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: A hand stirs scallion oil bubbling gently in a small saucepan.

com-tam-suon-nuong.zh: 手将葱油淋在配碎米和鲜菜的烤猪排上。
com-tam-suon-nuong.en: A hand spoons scallion oil over grilled pork served with broken rice and vegetables.

confit-de-canard.zh: 手把粗盐倒在浅盘里的生鸭腿上。
confit-de-canard.en: A hand pours coarse salt over raw duck legs in a shallow dish.

confit-de-canard.zh: 双手用厨房纸擦干水槽里的鸭腿。
confit-de-canard.en: Hands pat a duck leg dry with paper towel in a sink.

confit-de-canard.zh: 手把鸭腿放进小火加热的鸭油中。
confit-de-canard.en: A hand lowers a duck leg into duck fat over low heat.

confit-de-canard.zh: 手测量鸭油温度，锅边冒着细小气泡。
confit-de-canard.en: A hand checks the duck fat temperature as small bubbles rise at the edge.

confit-de-canard.zh: 手用宽铲托起油封鸭腿，旁边放着沥油网架。
confit-de-canard.en: A hand lifts a confit duck leg on a broad spatula beside a draining rack.

confit-de-canard.zh: 手用锅铲托住锅中鸭腿，露出金黄的皮。
confit-de-canard.en: A hand lifts a duck leg with a spatula in the pan, revealing golden skin.

cong-jian-dou-fu.zh: 双手将白豆腐切成薄片，切好的豆腐平放在盘中。
cong-jian-dou-fu.en: Hands slice white tofu into thin pieces, with cut slices laid flat on a plate.

cong-jian-dou-fu.zh: 双手切葱花，案板旁放着青椒块和调味水。
cong-jian-dou-fu.en: Hands chop scallions beside diced green chili and a bowl of seasoning water.

cong-jian-dou-fu.zh: 手将白豆腐片放入油锅，豆腐单层小火煎。
cong-jian-dou-fu.en: A hand places a white tofu slice in an oiled pan, where the slices fry in a single layer over low heat.

cong-jian-dou-fu.zh: 锅铲托起一片底面金黄的豆腐，准备翻面。
cong-jian-dou-fu.en: A spatula lifts a tofu slice with a golden underside to turn it over.

cong-jian-dou-fu.zh: 锅铲轻压锅中变软、表面微皱的青椒块。
cong-jian-dou-fu.en: A spatula gently presses softened, slightly wrinkled green chili pieces against the pan.

cong-jian-dou-fu.zh: 手将调味水倒入豆腐和青椒锅中，大火收汁。
cong-jian-dou-fu.en: A hand pours seasoning water into the pan of tofu and green chili over high heat.

cong-jian-dou-fu.zh: 锅铲将金黄豆腐、青椒和葱花盛入盘中。
cong-jian-dou-fu.en: A spatula transfers golden tofu, green chili, and scallions onto a plate.

cong-shao-hai-shen.zh: 手在切海参段，旁边摆着切好的葱白。
cong-shao-hai-shen.en: Hands cut sea cucumber into sections beside the prepared scallion whites.

cong-shao-hai-shen.zh: 手在搅拌料汁，旁边另放一碗水淀粉。
cong-shao-hai-shen.en: A hand stirs the sauce beside a separate bowl of starch slurry.

cong-shao-hai-shen.zh: 手用筷子翻动锅中煎至微黄的葱白。
cong-shao-hai-shen.en: A hand turns lightly golden scallion whites in the pan with chopsticks.

cong-shao-hai-shen.zh: 手用锅铲将棕色料汁沿锅底推散。
cong-shao-hai-shen.en: A hand spreads brown sauce across the bottom of the pan with a spatula.

cong-shao-hai-shen.zh: 手翻动轻沸酱汁中的海参段。
cong-shao-hai-shen.en: A hand turns sea cucumber sections in gently simmering sauce.

cong-shao-hai-shen.zh: 手边淋水淀粉边推拌锅中的海参和葱白。
cong-shao-hai-shen.en: Hands pour in starch slurry and stir the sea cucumber and scallion whites.

cong-shao-hai-shen.zh: 手将裹着亮汁的海参和葱白倒入盘中。
cong-shao-hai-shen.en: A hand tips glossy sea cucumber and scallion whites onto a plate.

cong-shao-ji-tui.zh: 用厨房剪沿鸡腿骨去骨，旁边摆着切好的鸡肉和葱姜。
cong-shao-ji-tui.en: Kitchen shears cut along a chicken leg bone beside prepared chicken, scallions, leek, and ginger.

cong-shao-ji-tui.zh: 用筷子拌匀腌料和鸡丁，旁边放着一碗料汁。
cong-shao-ji-tui.en: Chopsticks mix chicken with marinade beside a bowl of sauce.

cong-shao-ji-tui.zh: 小火中用筷子夹起油里的姜片和花椒。
cong-shao-ji-tui.en: Chopsticks lift ginger and Sichuan pepper from oil over low heat.

cong-shao-ji-tui.zh: 锅铲翻起单层煎着的鸡丁，露出褐色的一面。
cong-shao-ji-tui.en: A spatula turns a single layer of chicken cubes to reveal browned sides.

cong-shao-ji-tui.zh: 锅铲翻炒鸡丁和仍保持形状的大葱片。
cong-shao-ji-tui.en: A spatula stir-fries chicken cubes and intact leek rounds.

cong-shao-ji-tui.zh: 盖上锅盖，鸡丁和大葱在少量冒泡的料汁中短焖。
cong-shao-ji-tui.en: A lid is lowered over chicken and leek simmering in a little bubbling sauce.

cong-shao-ji-tui.zh: 往装盘的葱烧鸡腿上撒白芝麻。
cong-shao-ji-tui.en: A hand sprinkles white sesame over plated scallion chicken.

cong-you.zh: 用厨房纸吸干泡发沥干的开洋。
cong-you.en: A hand blots soaked and drained dried shrimp with kitchen paper.

cong-you.zh: 用厨房纸擦干洋葱丝，旁边摆着葱段和姜片。
cong-you.en: A hand blots onion strips beside scallion segments and ginger slices.

cong-you.zh: 小火翻动油中的葱段、洋葱、姜片和开洋，锅里冒着细泡。
cong-you.en: A hand turns scallions, onion, ginger and dried shrimp in gently bubbling oil over a low flame.

cong-you.zh: 关火后翻起金黄的洋葱和开始变褐的葱段，油里只剩少量泡沫。
cong-you.en: A hand lifts golden onion and browning scallions from the oil after the heat is turned off.
