cong-you.zh: 将金黄的葱油通过滤网倒入红边碗，滤出葱姜洋葱和开洋。
cong-you.en: Golden scallion oil is poured through a strainer into a red-rimmed bowl, catching the aromatics and shrimp.

cong-you-ban-mian.zh: 双手切葱段，葱白和葱绿分放，旁边放着调好的酱汁。
cong-you-ban-mian.en: Hands cut scallions into lengths, with whites and greens separated and mixed sauce nearby.

cong-you-ban-mian.zh: 葱白在油中轻轻冒泡，边缘微黄。
cong-you-ban-mian.en: Scallion whites bubble gently in oil, their edges turning pale gold.

cong-you-ban-mian.zh: 漏勺从油中捞出金黄酥脆的葱段。
cong-you-ban-mian.en: A slotted spoon lifts golden, crisp scallion segments from the oil.

cong-you-ban-mian.zh: 一只手把酱油糖汁慢慢倒进离火的葱油里。
cong-you-ban-mian.en: A hand slowly pours soy and sugar sauce into scallion oil off the heat.

cong-you-ban-mian.zh: 筷子在沸水中轻轻拨散细面条。
cong-you-ban-mian.en: Chopsticks gently separate thin noodles in boiling water.

cong-you-ban-mian.zh: 筷子翻拌裹着葱油酱的面条，碗里放着炸葱。
cong-you-ban-mian.en: Chopsticks toss sauce-coated noodles with fried scallions in a bowl.

cong-you-ban-mian.zh: 一只手把分别密封的葱油酱和炸葱放进冰箱。
cong-you-ban-mian.en: A hand places separately sealed scallion sauce and fried scallions in the refrigerator.

cong-you-bing.zh: 用筷子搅拌碗中的烫面，直到没有散粉。
cong-you-bing.en: Chopsticks stir hot-water dough in a bowl until no dry flour remains.

cong-you-bing.zh: 搅拌顺滑的油酥，葱花另放在小碗里。
cong-you-bing.en: A hand stirs smooth oil paste, with chopped scallions in a separate bowl.

cong-you-bing.zh: 用擀面杖把面团擀成均匀的长方形面片。
cong-you-bing.en: Hands roll the dough into an evenly thin rectangle.

cong-you-bing.zh: 双手从短边卷起抹了油酥和葱花的面片。
cong-you-bing.en: Hands roll the dough from a short edge over the oil paste and scallions.

cong-you-bing.zh: 平底锅里烙着两张饼，锅铲翻起金黄的饼底。
cong-you-bing.en: A spatula turns one of two pancakes in a pan, revealing its golden underside.

cong-you-bing.zh: 在晾架上切开金黄的葱油饼，露出层次。
cong-you-bing.en: A hand cuts a golden scallion pancake on a cooling rack, revealing its layers.

cong-you-gui-yu.zh: 手在整鱼厚肉处划刀，案板上摆着姜片、辣椒圈和葱段。
cong-you-gui-yu.en: A hand scores the thick flesh of a whole fish beside ginger slices, chili rings and scallion segments.

cong-you-gui-yu.zh: 手把姜片塞入鱼身刀口，旁边放着盐和料酒。
cong-you-gui-yu.en: A hand tucks ginger slices into cuts in the fish, beside bowls of salt and cooking wine.

cong-you-gui-yu.zh: 手把姜片铺在蒸笼中盘好的整鱼上，盘子四周留有空隙。
cong-you-gui-yu.en: A hand lays ginger slices on a whole fish in a platter with space around it in the steamer.

cong-you-gui-yu.zh: 叉子拨开蒸鱼厚肉，露出不透明的白色鱼肉。
cong-you-gui-yu.en: A fork separates opaque white flakes from the thickest part of the steamed fish.

cong-you-gui-yu.zh: 手将豉油淋入鱼盘底部，葱段和辣椒圈放在旁边。
cong-you-gui-yu.en: A hand spoons seasoned soy sauce into the fish platter, with scallion and chili waiting nearby.

cong-you-gui-yu.zh: 手将热油淋在鱼身的葱段上，葱边泛起细泡。
cong-you-gui-yu.en: A hand pours hot oil over scallions on the fish, forming small bubbles.

cong-you-ji.zh: 手持勺子撇去鸡腿汤表面的浮沫。
cong-you-ji.en: A hand skims foam from the surface of the chicken broth.

cong-you-ji.zh: 手将探针插入鸡腿最厚处测温。
cong-you-ji.en: A hand inserts a thermometer probe into the thickest part of a drumstick.

cong-you-ji.zh: 双手将去骨去皮的熟鸡肉撕成块。
cong-you-ji.en: Hands tear the cooked, boneless and skinless chicken into pieces.

cong-you-ji.zh: 手用漏勺捞出油中边缘浅褐的葱白。
cong-you-ji.en: A hand lifts lightly browned scallion whites from the oil with a slotted spoon.

cong-you-ji.zh: 手在热油中搅拌鲜绿的葱末和姜蓉。
cong-you-ji.en: A hand stirs bright green scallions and grated ginger in hot oil.

cong-you-ji.zh: 手用筷子轻拌盘中的鸡肉和葱姜油。
cong-you-ji.en: A hand gently tosses chicken with scallion and ginger oil using chopsticks.

coq-au-vin.zh: 用漏勺捞出水中轻煮过的培根粗条。
coq-au-vin.en: Lift gently simmered thick bacon strips from the water with a slotted spoon.

coq-au-vin.zh: 用夹子翻煎至金棕的鸡块，锅底留有褐色沉积。
coq-au-vin.en: Turn golden-brown chicken with tongs above the browned bits in the pan.

coq-au-vin.zh: 将红酒倒入鸡块与培根中，用木勺刮起锅底沉积。
coq-au-vin.en: Pour red wine over the chicken and bacon while scraping the browned bits with a wooden spoon.

coq-au-vin.zh: 用探针测量红酒炖汁中鸡胸的中心温度。
coq-au-vin.en: Check the center of a chicken breast in the red wine broth with a probe.

coq-au-vin.zh: 用木勺翻动煎至斑驳金黄的珍珠洋葱。
coq-au-vin.en: Roll pearl onions with a wooden spoon until patchily golden.

coq-au-vin.zh: 用木勺翻炒表面金黄的整颗及切半蘑菇。
coq-au-vin.en: Toss whole and halved mushrooms with a wooden spoon until golden.

coq-au-vin.zh: 提起木勺查看红酒酱汁挂勺的状态。
coq-au-vin.en: Lift a wooden spoon to check the coating of red wine sauce.

cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.zh: 手用厨房纸擦猪排，旁边备有洋葱末、酸黄瓜条和褐色浓酱。
cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.en: A hand pats pork chops dry beside minced onion, cornichon strips and brown sauce.

cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.zh: 手用夹子翻开猪排，锅中肉块间留有空隙，底面均匀褐色。
cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.en: A hand turns a pork chop to reveal its browned underside, with space between the chops.

cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.zh: 手将温度计从侧面插入锅中已上色猪排的厚处。
cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.en: A hand inserts a thermometer into the thick side of a browned pork chop in the pan.

cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.zh: 手用木铲翻炒黄油中的透明洋葱末，锅底留有褐色煎痕。
cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.en: A hand stirs translucent minced onion in butter over browned pan fond.

cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.zh: 手用木铲刮起锅底，洋葱浸在浅浅的白葡萄酒液中。
cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.en: A hand scrapes the pan while onions sit in a shallow layer of white wine.

cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.zh: 手举起挂有褐色酱汁的勺子，勺上的划痕保持清晰。
cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.en: A hand holds a spoon coated with brown sauce, showing a clear streak.

cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.zh: 手将带洋葱和酸黄瓜条的酱汁舀在盘中猪排上。
cotes-de-porc-charcutieres.en: A hand spoons onion and cornichon sauce over a plated pork chop.

cotoletta-alla-milanese.zh: 用肉锤平面轻拍案板上的带骨肉排。
cotoletta-alla-milanese.en: A hand gently taps a bone-in chop on a cutting board with a flat meat mallet.

cotoletta-alla-milanese.zh: 用手将蘸过蛋液的肉排压入面包糠，骨柄露在外面。
cotoletta-alla-milanese.en: A hand presses an egg-coated chop into breadcrumbs, leaving the bone exposed.

cotoletta-alla-milanese.zh: 平底锅里的黄油融化起泡，铺满锅底。
cotoletta-alla-milanese.en: Butter melts and foams across the bottom of a frying pan.

cotoletta-alla-milanese.zh: 用宽铲和夹子翻动肉排，金黄的黄油在锅中起泡。
cotoletta-alla-milanese.en: A spatula and tongs turn the chop in bubbling golden butter.

cotoletta-alla-milanese.zh: 将温度计探针从侧面插入锅中金黄的肉排。
cotoletta-alla-milanese.en: A thermometer probe is inserted into the side of a golden chop in the pan.

cotoletta-alla-milanese.zh: 往盘中的金黄肉排上撒盐，旁边摆着柠檬角。
cotoletta-alla-milanese.en: A hand sprinkles salt over a golden chop served with lemon wedges.

creme-anglaise.zh: 小锅里的香草牛奶边缘冒细泡，升起蒸汽。
creme-anglaise.en: Vanilla milk steams in a saucepan with tiny bubbles around the edge.

creme-anglaise.zh: 一边搅拌蛋黄糖液，一边缓缓倒入热牛奶。
creme-anglaise.en: Hot milk is slowly poured into the yolk and sugar mixture while it is whisked.

creme-anglaise.zh: 小火加热蛋奶液，用刮刀刮拌锅底和锅角。
creme-anglaise.en: A spatula scrapes the bottom and corner of the saucepan over low heat.

creme-anglaise.zh: 勺背挂着蛋奶酱薄膜，划过的线清晰可见。
creme-anglaise.en: A clear line remains in the thin coating of custard on the back of a spoon.

creme-anglaise.zh: 蛋奶酱经细筛倒入碗中，香草荚和小凝块留在筛上。
creme-anglaise.en: Custard is poured through a fine sieve, leaving the vanilla pod and small lumps behind.

creme-anglaise.zh: 用勺子轻轻搅拌碗中顺滑的香草蛋奶酱。
creme-anglaise.en: A spoon gently stirs smooth vanilla custard in a bowl.

creme-brulee.zh: 小锅里的奶油边缘微微冒汽。
creme-brulee.en: Cream releases wisps of steam around the edge of a small saucepan.

creme-brulee.zh: 一边将温奶油倒入蛋黄糖液，一边轻轻搅拌。
creme-brulee.en: Warm cream is poured into the yolk and sugar mixture while it is gently stirred.

creme-brulee.zh: 蛋奶液经过细筛倒入浅烤盅。
creme-brulee.en: Custard mixture is poured through a fine sieve into shallow ramekins.

creme-brulee.zh: 在烤箱中向装有烤盅的深烤盘缓缓注水。
creme-brulee.en: Hot water is carefully poured into the pan around the ramekins in the oven.

creme-brulee.zh: 轻摇烤盅，观察蛋奶冻中心轻晃。
creme-brulee.en: A ramekin is gently shaken to check the custard's softly jiggling center.

creme-brulee.zh: 将烤好的蛋奶冻放在架上散热。
creme-brulee.en: The baked custards are placed on a rack to cool.

creme-brulee.zh: 移动喷枪，将蛋奶冻表面的糖烧成琥珀色。
creme-brulee.en: A torch moves over the custard to melt the sugar into an amber crust.

creme-caramel.zh: 轻转小锅，锅内焦糖呈均匀琥珀色。
creme-caramel.en: Gently swirl the saucepan of evenly amber caramel.

creme-caramel.zh: 戴隔热手套倾斜模具，让焦糖铺开。
creme-caramel.en: Tilt the mold with oven mitts to spread the caramel.

creme-caramel.zh: 轻搅蛋液，旁边的牛奶锅边冒着细泡。
creme-caramel.en: Gently stir the eggs while small bubbles form at the edge of the milk.

creme-caramel.zh: 将蛋奶液过筛倒入沾有焦糖的模具。
creme-caramel.en: Strain the custard mixture into the caramel-coated mold.

creme-caramel.zh: 向放有蛋奶液模具的深烤盘注水。
creme-caramel.en: Pour water into the deep baking pan around the custard mold.

creme-caramel.zh: 抬起倒扣的模具，焦糖汁流到布丁和盘中。
creme-caramel.en: Lift the inverted mold as caramel sauce runs over the custard and onto the plate.

crepes.zh: 用打蛋器搅匀碗中的蛋黄和液体。
crepes.en: A whisk blends the egg yolks and liquids in a bowl.

crepes.zh: 舀起的面糊连续淌回碗中。
crepes.en: A ladleful of batter flows continuously back into the bowl.

crepes.zh: 用勺轻轻搅匀碗中的面糊。
crepes.en: A spoon gently stirs the batter in a bowl.

crepes.zh: 提起平底锅转动，让面糊铺满锅底。
crepes.en: A hand tilts the skillet to spread batter across its base.

crepes.zh: 用薄铲翻起定形的饼，露出浅褐色斑点。
crepes.en: A thin spatula lifts the set crêpe, revealing light brown spots.
Hands cover a stack of cooked crêpes.

crepes.zh: 在盘中将薄饼折成四折。
crepes.en: Hands fold a crêpe into quarters on a plate.

croque-monsieur.zh: 八片吐司分两组摆好，手正把奶酪擦入碗中。
croque-monsieur.en: Eight bread slices lie in two groups as hands grate cheese into a bowl.

croque-monsieur.zh: 小火下用打蛋器搅拌浅色、起细泡的黄油面糊。
croque-monsieur.en: A whisk stirs pale, finely bubbling butter and flour over low heat.

croque-monsieur.zh: 浓白酱从勺上落成宽带，流回小锅。
croque-monsieur.en: Thick béchamel falls from a spoon back into the saucepan in a wide ribbon.

croque-monsieur.zh: 离火后用勺推开浓稠的白酱，旁边摆着调味料。
croque-monsieur.en: A spoon pushes thick béchamel in an off-heat saucepan beside the seasonings.

croque-monsieur.zh: 在铺了火腿和芥末的吐司上薄抹白酱。
croque-monsieur.en: A thin layer of béchamel is spread over ham and mustard on bread.

croque-monsieur.zh: 在抹了白酱的三明治顶面撒上奶酪碎。
croque-monsieur.en: Grated cheese is scattered over béchamel-topped sandwiches.

croque-monsieur.zh: 金褐色芝士火腿三明治斜切后摆在红边盘上。
croque-monsieur.en: Golden-brown ham and cheese sandwiches are cut diagonally on a red-rimmed plate.

crostata.zh: 双手将黄油和粉类搓成粗砂，旁边放着蛋液。
crostata.en: Hands rub butter and dry ingredients into coarse crumbs beside beaten egg.

crostata.zh: 蛋液倒入酥皮碎屑，刮刀轻轻拌合。
crostata.en: Beaten egg is poured into pastry crumbs as a spatula gently mixes them.

crostata.zh: 双手将面皮压进挞模，旁边留有一份面团。
crostata.en: Hands press pastry into a tart pan, with reserved dough beside it.

crostata.zh: 用勺子将深红色果酱均匀铺在挞皮上。
crostata.en: A spoon spreads dark red jam evenly over the pastry shell.

crostata.zh: 双手在果酱上交错铺放面条。
crostata.en: Hands lay a pastry strip across the lattice over the jam.

crostata.zh: 烤箱里的挞边和格子金黄，果酱局部冒泡。
crostata.en: The tart bakes in the oven with golden pastry and bubbling jam.

crostata.zh: 在红边白盘上切开放凉的果酱格子挞。
crostata.en: A cooled jam lattice tart is sliced on a white plate with a red rim.

cui-pi-dou-fu.zh: 手用筷子在浅碗中搅打均匀的蛋液。
cui-pi-dou-fu.en: Hands beat the eggs into a uniform mixture in a shallow bowl.

cui-pi-dou-fu.zh: 手在碗中搅拌均匀的棕色酱汁。
cui-pi-dou-fu.en: Hands stir a smooth brown sauce in a bowl.

cui-pi-dou-fu.zh: 手用纸巾轻吸案板上豆腐片的表面水分。
cui-pi-dou-fu.en: A hand gently blots the tofu slices on a cutting board with a paper towel.

cui-pi-dou-fu.zh: 手夹起蘸过蛋液的豆腐片，让余液滴回碗中。
cui-pi-dou-fu.en: A hand lifts an egg-coated tofu slice and lets excess egg drip into the bowl.

cui-pi-dou-fu.zh: 手将豆腐片放入小火平底锅，与其他豆腐单层煎制。
cui-pi-dou-fu.en: A hand places a tofu slice in a lightly oiled pan alongside a single layer of slices over low heat.

cui-pi-dou-fu.zh: 手用铲子翻起底面金黄定形的豆腐片。
cui-pi-dou-fu.en: A hand turns a tofu slice with a spatula, revealing its set golden underside.

cui-pi-dou-fu.zh: 手轻晃锅子，浓亮的酱汁沸腾并裹住豆腐。
cui-pi-dou-fu.en: A hand gently shakes the pan as glossy thick sauce bubbles around and coats the tofu.

da-zhu-gan-si.zh: 双手用平放的刀将白豆干批成薄片。
da-zhu-gan-si.en: Hands slice a block of pressed tofu into a thin sheet with a horizontal knife.

da-zhu-gan-si.zh: 用筷子拨散热水中浸烫的白干丝。
da-zhu-gan-si.en: Chopsticks separate pressed tofu shreds soaking in hot water.

da-zhu-gan-si.zh: 用勺轻推鸡汤中微沸的干丝、火腿丝和笋丝。
da-zhu-gan-si.en: A spoon gently pushes tofu, ham and bamboo shreds in simmering chicken broth.

da-zhu-gan-si.zh: 用筷子夹起锅中柔软垂下的干丝。
da-zhu-gan-si.en: Chopsticks lift softened tofu shreds from the gently simmering pot.

da-zhu-gan-si.zh: 将干丝、虾仁和菜心连汤盛入深盘。
da-zhu-gan-si.en: A ladle serves tofu shreds, shrimp, greens and broth into a deep bowl.

dai-ba-zhou-zi.zh: 双手从生肘子断骨处拣出碎骨，脚爪保持完整。
dai-ba-zhou-zi.en: Hands remove loose bone fragments from the cut end of a raw pork hock with its trotter intact.

dai-ba-zhou-zi.zh: 小火煮锅里，漏勺托起皮已收紧的整只肘子。
dai-ba-zhou-zi.en: A skimmer lifts the whole hock with tightened skin from a gently simmering pot.

dai-ba-zhou-zi.zh: 双手将肘子皮朝下放入铺有八角和桂皮的深盘。
dai-ba-zhou-zi.en: Hands place the hock skin-side down in a deep dish with star anise and cassia.

dai-ba-zhou-zi.zh: 勺子将带蒜片和姜末的酱料摊在盖着葱和肘肉的纱布上。
dai-ba-zhou-zi.en: A spoon spreads sauce with garlic slices and minced ginger over gauze covering scallions and pork.

dai-ba-zhou-zi.zh: 带盖蒸锅在火上持续冒出蒸汽。
dai-ba-zhou-zi.en: Steam escapes continuously from a covered steamer over a flame.

dai-ba-zhou-zi.zh: 勺子向装盘的肘子淋汁，旁边配葱段和甜面酱。
dai-ba-zhou-zi.en: A spoon pours juices over the plated hock beside scallions and sweet bean sauce.

dak-galbi.zh: 双手在冷水中分开年糕片。
dak-galbi.en: Hands separate sliced rice cakes in cold water.

dak-galbi.zh: 用勺将鸡块拌匀红酱，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜。
dak-galbi.en: A spoon coats chicken pieces in red sauce beside prepared vegetables.

dak-galbi.zh: 中大火翻炒鸡块、包菜、红薯和年糕。
dak-galbi.en: Chicken, cabbage, sweet potato and rice cakes are stirred over medium-high heat.

dak-galbi.zh: 中火从锅底翻起食材，锅底留有一层酱汁。
dak-galbi.en: A spatula lifts the ingredients from the bottom over medium heat, with sauce remaining in the pan.

dak-galbi.zh: 将葱段和苏子叶倒入锅中的鸡肉与蔬菜。
dak-galbi.en: Scallion pieces and perilla strips are tipped into the pan of chicken and vegetables.

dak-galbi.zh: 双手端起离火的辣炒鸡排，食材薄薄裹着酱汁。
dak-galbi.en: Hands hold the pan of finished dak-galbi off the heat, its ingredients lightly coated in sauce.

dakbokkeumtang.zh: 用剪刀剪去鸡腿多余的脂肪，旁边放着切好的土豆和蔬菜。
dakbokkeumtang.en: Hands trim excess fat from chicken legs beside cut potatoes and vegetables.

dakbokkeumtang.zh: 用勺翻拌鸡块，让每块都裹上红色炖汁。
dakbokkeumtang.en: A spoon turns chicken pieces in red sauce until coated.

dakbokkeumtang.zh: 锅中鸡块已变色，红色汤汁冒泡并浮着鸡油，手正翻动鸡肉。
dakbokkeumtang.en: A hand turns the cooked-looking chicken in bubbling red sauce dotted with chicken fat.

dakbokkeumtang.zh: 用勺将土豆、胡萝卜、洋葱、蒜和姜轻拌入鸡肉炖汁。
dakbokkeumtang.en: A spoon gently folds potatoes, carrots, onions, garlic and ginger into the chicken stew.

dakbokkeumtang.zh: 用筷子扎锅中的土豆块，检查是否软透。
dakbokkeumtang.en: Chopsticks pierce a potato chunk in the simmering chicken stew.

dakbokkeumtang.zh: 将红色浓汤浇在鸡块上，锅中有蔬菜和葱，旁边配米饭。
dakbokkeumtang.en: A ladle pours red sauce over chicken and vegetables beside a bowl of rice.

dakjuk.zh: 双手将泡白的米倒入筛中沥水。
dakjuk.en: Hands pour soaked white rice into a sieve to drain.

dakjuk.zh: 用漏勺从微沸的鸡汤中捞出熟鸡块。
dakjuk.en: A slotted spoon lifts cooked chicken pieces from gently simmering stock.

dakjuk.zh: 双手将熟鸡肉顺纹撕丝，旁边备有调味料。
dakjuk.en: Hands shred cooked chicken along the grain beside prepared seasonings.

dakjuk.zh: 用木勺翻炒香油中的米，米粒浅色发亮。
dakjuk.en: A wooden spoon stirs pale, glossy rice in sesame oil.

dakjuk.zh: 用木勺搅动逐渐变稠的米粥。
dakjuk.en: A wooden spoon stirs rice porridge as it thickens.

dakjuk.zh: 用木勺在粥锅边压软胡萝卜、芹菜和香菇丁。
dakjuk.en: A wooden spoon presses diced carrot, celery and shiitake against the pot of porridge.

dakjuk.zh: 手在盛好的鸡丝蔬菜粥上撒葱花。
dakjuk.en: A hand scatters scallions over a bowl of chicken and vegetable porridge.

dan-dan-mian.zh: 用筷子拌散猪肉末，旁边摆着切好的配料和芝麻酱。
dan-dan-mian.en: Chopsticks mix the ground pork beside prepared aromatics, bok choy and sesame paste.

dan-dan-mian.zh: 用筷子拨散锅中边缘微褐、汁水炒干的肉末。
dan-dan-mian.en: Chopsticks separate the pork, now dry with lightly browned edges.

dan-dan-mian.zh: 小火翻炒干爽的肉末、芽菜、姜末和辣椒面。
dan-dan-mian.en: Pork, ya cai, ginger and chili flakes are stirred over a small flame until dry.

dan-dan-mian.zh: 往芝麻酱中倒水，勺上的酱光滑地流下。
dan-dan-mian.en: Water is poured into sesame paste as smooth sauce flows from a spoon.

dan-dan-mian.zh: 大火煮面和小白菜，用筷子拨开沸水中的面条。
dan-dan-mian.en: Chopsticks separate noodles and bok choy in vigorously boiling water.

dan-dan-mian.zh: 用筷子翻拌担担面，碗里有肉臊、花生碎、葱花和小白菜。
dan-dan-mian.en: Chopsticks toss glossy noodles with pork topping, peanuts, scallions and bok choy.

dan-huang-su.zh: 双手将水油皮拉成薄膜，旁边摆着面粉、糖、猪油和水。
dan-huang-su.en: Hands stretch the water-oil dough into a thin membrane, with flour, sugar, lard and water nearby.

dan-huang-su.zh: 双手用豆沙包住咸蛋黄，旁边放着面粉和面团。
dan-huang-su.en: Hands wrap red bean paste around a salted egg yolk, with flour and dough nearby.

dan-huang-su.zh: 双手将水油皮包住油酥并收口，旁边的面团盖着布。
dan-huang-su.en: Hands pinch water-oil dough around a pastry dough ball, beside covered portions.

dan-huang-su.zh: 双手从短边卷起椭圆面片，旁边放着擀面杖。
dan-huang-su.en: Hands roll an oval dough sheet from its short edge, with a rolling pin nearby.

dan-huang-su.zh: 双手收拢面皮包住豆沙馅球，旁边放着面卷和擀面杖。
dan-huang-su.en: Hands close a pastry wrapper around a red bean filling ball, beside a dough roll and rolling pin.

dan-huang-su.zh: 手在刷过蛋黄液的生坯上撒黑芝麻，八个生坯排在烤盘上。
dan-huang-su.en: A hand sprinkles black sesame over eight egg-washed raw pastries on a tray.

dan-huang-su.zh: 金黄的蛋黄酥在网架上晾凉，切面露出豆沙和蛋黄。
dan-huang-su.en: Golden pastries cool on a rack, one cut open to reveal red bean paste and yolk.

dan-jian-ci-ba.zh: 用刀将白糍粑切成粗细均匀的长条。
dan-jian-ci-ba.en: A hand cuts white rice cakes into evenly sized rectangular sticks.

dan-jian-ci-ba.zh: 用筷子翻动碗中糍粑，让它裹上蛋液。
dan-jian-ci-ba.en: Chopsticks turn rice cake sticks in a bowl of beaten egg.

dan-jian-ci-ba.zh: 小火油锅中，手将裹蛋液的糍粑间隔放入。
dan-jian-ci-ba.en: A hand spaces egg-coated rice cake sticks in a lightly oiled pan over low heat.

dan-jian-ci-ba.zh: 小火煎锅中，用铲子翻起底面凝固的糍粑。
dan-jian-ci-ba.en: A spatula flips a rice cake stick with a set golden underside over low heat.

dan-jian-ci-ba.zh: 锅中糍粑煎至金黄，铲起的一块露出白色内芯。
dan-jian-ci-ba.en: Golden rice cake sticks cook in a pan, with a cut piece showing its white center.

dan-jian-ci-ba.zh: 手将红糖撒在盘中金黄的蛋煎糍粑上。
dan-jian-ci-ba.en: A hand sprinkles brown sugar over golden egg-fried rice cakes on a plate.

dashi.zh: 手将带白霜的昆布放入冷水锅中。
dashi.en: A hand lowers kombu with its white coating into a pot of cold water.

dashi.zh: 锅边冒细泡时，用筷子夹出泡软的昆布。
dashi.en: Chopsticks lift softened kombu from the pot as small bubbles form at the edge.

dashi.zh: 手将柴鱼片倒入浅金色的汤中。
dashi.en: A hand pours bonito flakes into the pale golden broth.

dashi.zh: 柴鱼片沉落后，用漏勺撇去汤面浮沫。
dashi.en: A skimmer removes foam from the broth after the bonito flakes have sunk.

dashi.zh: 将汤倒入铺纱布的细筛，清汤滴入碗中。
dashi.en: Broth is poured through a cheesecloth-lined sieve and drips into a bowl.

dau-hu-nhoi-thit.zh: 双手切碎香菇，旁边的豆腐夹在厨房纸间。
dau-hu-nhoi-thit.en: Hands chop shiitake mushrooms beside tofu resting between paper towels.

dau-hu-nhoi-thit.zh: 用漏勺捞出烫至切口卷皮的番茄。
dau-hu-nhoi-thit.en: A slotted spoon lifts a tomato with curled skin from boiling water.

dau-hu-nhoi-thit.zh: 双手从侧面横切豆腐，旁边放着拌好的肉馅。
dau-hu-nhoi-thit.en: Hands cut a tofu slice horizontally beside a bowl of mixed pork filling.

dau-hu-nhoi-thit.zh: 托住豆腐掀开上片，用勺子铺入肉馅。
dau-hu-nhoi-thit.en: One hand opens a tofu pocket while the other spreads in pork filling.

dau-hu-nhoi-thit.zh: 用两把锅铲托起锅中煎至金黄的酿豆腐。
dau-hu-nhoi-thit.en: Two spatulas lift golden stuffed tofu from the frying pan.

dau-hu-nhoi-thit.zh: 用夹子将金黄的酿豆腐放到番茄汁上。
dau-hu-nhoi-thit.en: Tongs place golden stuffed tofu on a plate of tomato sauce.

dau-hu-xa-ot.zh: 双手把生豆腐切成厚片。
dau-hu-xa-ot.en: Hands slice a block of raw tofu into thick slices.

dau-hu-xa-ot.zh: 用勺子将豆腐与香茅、红葱头、辣椒和盐轻轻拌匀。
dau-hu-xa-ot.en: A spoon gently mixes tofu with lemongrass, shallot, chili and salt.

dau-hu-xa-ot.zh: 用锅铲翻动平底锅中煎至金黄的豆腐片。
dau-hu-xa-ot.en: A spatula turns golden tofu slices in a frying pan.

dau-hu-xa-ot.zh: 用勺子把金黄的香料碎撒在煎豆腐上。
dau-hu-xa-ot.en: A spoon scatters golden minced aromatics over fried tofu.

dau-que-xao-bo.zh: 手持勺子拌匀碗里的生牛肉和调味料。
dau-que-xao-bo.en: A hand mixes raw beef and seasonings in a bowl with a spoon.

dau-que-xao-bo.zh: 四季豆和胡萝卜丝倒入沸水中。
dau-que-xao-bo.en: Green beans and carrot strips are tipped into boiling water.

dau-que-xao-bo.zh: 锅中翻炒四季豆、胡萝卜丝和蒜末。
dau-que-xao-bo.en: Green beans, carrot strips and minced garlic are stirred in a pan.

dau-que-xao-bo.zh: 蚝油淋在平铺锅中、略带粉红的牛肉上。
dau-que-xao-bo.en: Oyster sauce is poured over beef spread in the pan, still slightly pink.

dau-que-xao-bo.zh: 手往装盘的四季豆炒牛肉上撒黑胡椒。
dau-que-xao-bo.en: A hand sprinkles black pepper over the plated beef and green beans.

dau-sot-ca-chua.zh: 手把沥干的豆腐切成厚片，旁边放着厨房纸。
dau-sot-ca-chua.en: Hands cut drained tofu into thick slabs beside kitchen paper.

dau-sot-ca-chua.zh: 手切番茄丁，旁边摆着番茄汁、葱蒜和调料。
dau-sot-ca-chua.en: Hands dice tomatoes beside their juices, aromatics, and seasonings.

dau-sot-ca-chua.zh: 手用锅铲翻动锅里煎至金黄的豆腐。
dau-sot-ca-chua.en: A hand turns golden tofu in a frying pan with a spatula.

dau-sot-ca-chua.zh: 手用锅铲压散小火煮至略稠的番茄汁。
dau-sot-ca-chua.en: A hand presses soft tomatoes into a gently simmering sauce with a spatula.

dau-sot-ca-chua.zh: 手把番茄汁淋在小火煨着的豆腐上。
dau-sot-ca-chua.en: A hand spoons tomato sauce over tofu simmering on low heat.

dau-sot-ca-chua.zh: 手将裹着番茄汁和葱绿的豆腐盛到盘中。
dau-sot-ca-chua.en: A hand plates tofu coated in tomato sauce and scallion greens.

demi-glace.zh: 小火翻拌锅中均匀的榛褐色面糊。
demi-glace.en: Stir the evenly hazelnut-brown roux over low heat.

demi-glace.zh: 离火倒入棕高汤，搅匀棕色面糊。
demi-glace.en: Whisk brown stock into the brown roux off the heat.

demi-glace.zh: 小火翻炒五花肉丁、蔬菜丁和香草。
demi-glace.en: Sauté diced pork belly, vegetables and herbs over low heat.

demi-glace.zh: 将白葡萄酒倒入锅中溶出褐色沉积。
demi-glace.en: Pour white wine into the pan to loosen the brown deposits.

demi-glace.zh: 用勺轻压筛中的蔬菜，让酱汁流入锅中。
demi-glace.en: Gently press the vegetables in a sieve to drain the sauce into a pan.

demi-glace.zh: 将番茄泥倒入轻沸的棕色酱汁中。
demi-glace.en: Pour tomato purée into the gently simmering brown sauce.

demi-glace.zh: 轻沸的酱汁薄薄挂在勺背，划痕清晰。
demi-glace.en: The gently simmered sauce coats the spoon in a thin layer with a clear streak.

demi-glace.zh: 将半釉汁通过细筛滤入酱汁船。
demi-glace.en: Strain the demi-glace through a fine sieve into a gravy boat.

di-san-xian.zh: 用布擦干尖椒片，案板上放着切好的土豆和茄子。
di-san-xian.en: A hand dries a pepper piece beside cut potatoes and eggplant.

di-san-xian.zh: 搅拌碗里的调汁，旁边放着切好的葱、姜和蒜。
di-san-xian.en: A hand stirs the sauce beside chopped scallion, ginger and garlic.

di-san-xian.zh: 用筷子扎锅中金黄的土豆块，油正冒着泡。
di-san-xian.en: Chopsticks pierce a golden potato wedge in bubbling oil.

di-san-xian.zh: 用筷子翻动油锅中略微上色的茄子块。
di-san-xian.en: Chopsticks turn lightly browned eggplant in bubbling oil.

di-san-xian.zh: 用漏勺捞起油锅里边缘微皱的青椒片。
di-san-xian.en: A slotted spoon lifts a slightly wrinkled green pepper piece from oil.

di-san-xian.zh: 大火下用铲推动锅中冒泡的红色酱汁。
di-san-xian.en: A spatula pushes bubbling red sauce over high heat.

di-san-xian.zh: 关火后把裹着酱汁的土豆、茄子和尖椒盛入盘中。
di-san-xian.en: The sauced potatoes, eggplant and peppers are tipped onto a plate off the heat.

dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.zh: 双手将米杯里的干米刮平。
dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.en: Hands level dry rice in a rice measuring cup.

dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.zh: 手指在内锅里轻轻拨洗浑水中的米。
dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.en: Fingers gently swirl rice in cloudy water in the inner pot.

dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.zh: 手往盛有生米的内锅加水，水面接近刻线。
dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.en: A hand pours water over uncooked rice in the inner pot near the level mark.

dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.zh: 手按下盖好的电饭煲启动按钮。
dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.en: A hand presses the start button on the closed rice cooker.

dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.zh: 电饭煲盖着并接通电源，指示灯亮着。
dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.en: The closed rice cooker remains plugged in with its indicator lit.

dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.zh: 电饭煲开盖，内锅里是蓬松的白米饭。
dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.en: The open rice cooker reveals fluffy white rice in its inner pot.

dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.zh: 手用饭勺翻松锅里的米饭，旁边盛有一碗饭。
dian-fan-bao-zheng-mi-fan.en: A hand fluffs rice with a paddle beside a bowl of rice.

do-chua.zh: 双手将白萝卜叠片切条，案板上摆着白萝卜和胡萝卜条。
do-chua.en: Hands cut stacked daikon slices into sticks beside cut daikon and carrot.

do-chua.zh: 一手揉碗里的萝卜丝，另一手将白萝卜条弯曲。
do-chua.en: One hand massages the vegetable sticks while the other bends a daikon stick.

do-chua.zh: 双手托着滤篮，在水龙头下冲洗白萝卜和胡萝卜条。
do-chua.en: Hands hold a colander of daikon and carrot sticks under running water.

do-chua.zh: 双手扶碗搅拌清澈腌汁，碗底看不到糖粒。
do-chua.en: Hands stir clear pickling liquid with no visible sugar grains in the bowl.

do-chua.zh: 一手扶罐，一手用勺将萝卜和胡萝卜条压入腌汁。
do-chua.en: One hand steadies the jar while the other presses daikon and carrot below the brine with a spoon.

do-chua.zh: 筷子从罐中夹起萝卜和胡萝卜条沥汁，旁边放着一碗腌菜。
do-chua.en: Chopsticks lift daikon and carrot sticks from the jar to drain beside a bowl of pickles.

doenjang-jjigae.zh: 手在案板上切蒜末，旁边摆着切好的蔬菜和辣椒圈。
doenjang-jjigae.en: Hands mince garlic beside diced vegetables and chili rings on a cutting board.

doenjang-jjigae.zh: 手剔除鳀鱼内脏，旁边备有纱袋、虾仁、豆腐和葱。
doenjang-jjigae.en: Hands remove anchovy innards beside a soup bag, shrimp, tofu and scallions.

doenjang-jjigae.zh: 手向装有蔬菜、虾仁和鳀鱼袋的锅中倒水。
doenjang-jjigae.en: A hand pours water into a pot of vegetables, shrimp and a bag of anchovies.

doenjang-jjigae.zh: 锅中汤汁冒泡，手用勺轻翻蔬菜和不透明的虾仁。
doenjang-jjigae.en: A hand gently turns vegetables and opaque shrimp in the bubbling broth.

doenjang-jjigae.zh: 手将化开的棕色大酱汤汁倒入锅中。
doenjang-jjigae.en: A hand pours dissolved soybean paste and broth into the pot.

doenjang-jjigae.zh: 手用勺轻推锅中棱角完整的豆腐丁。
doenjang-jjigae.en: A hand gently pushes intact tofu cubes into the stew with a spoon.

doenjang-jjigae.zh: 手向大酱汤撒葱，黑锅放在隔热垫上，旁边有白饭。
doenjang-jjigae.en: A hand sprinkles scallions over stew in a pot on a trivet beside white rice.

dong-an-zi-ji.zh: 整鸡与姜、葱在深锅中小火煮至表皮发白。
dong-an-zi-ji.en: A whole chicken simmers with ginger and scallion until its skin turns pale.

dong-an-zi-ji.zh: 整鸡放在托盘上沥水散热，旁边留有鸡汤。
dong-an-zi-ji.en: A whole chicken drains and cools on a tray beside reserved broth.

dong-an-zi-ji.zh: 手将带皮鸡肉切条，旁边摆着姜丝、椒丝、葱绿和淀粉浆。
dong-an-zi-ji.en: Hands cut skin-on chicken into strips beside ginger, chili, scallion greens, and starch slurry.

dong-an-zi-ji.zh: 姜丝和红椒丝在化开的猪油中翻炒，颜色仍鲜亮。
dong-an-zi-ji.en: Ginger and bright red chili strips are stirred in melted lard.

dong-an-zi-ji.zh: 手沿锅边淋入绍兴酒，锅中鸡肉与姜椒已沾油。
dong-an-zi-ji.en: A hand pours Shaoxing wine along the wok edge over oiled chicken, ginger, and chili.

dong-an-zi-ji.zh: 手舀起浅浅的汤汁浇在鸡肉上，锅中汁水冒泡。
dong-an-zi-ji.en: A hand spoons shallow bubbling sauce over the chicken in the wok.

dong-an-zi-ji.zh: 手将带皮鸡肉、姜丝、红椒和葱绿盛入白盘。
dong-an-zi-ji.en: A hand transfers skin-on chicken, ginger, red chili, and scallion greens onto a white plate.

dong-gua-cha.zh: 手将去皮去籽的冬瓜切成大小相近的小块。
dong-gua-cha.en: Hands cut peeled and deseeded winter melon into evenly sized chunks.

dong-gua-cha.zh: 手将冬瓜、冰糖和析出的汁水一起倒入锅中。
dong-gua-cha.en: Hands pour winter melon, rock sugar and accumulated juice into a saucepan.

dong-gua-cha.zh: 手用木勺翻动轻沸的冬瓜块。
dong-gua-cha.en: A hand stirs winter melon chunks in gently simmering liquid.

dong-gua-cha.zh: 手用勺背轻压锅里半透明的冬瓜块。
dong-gua-cha.en: A hand presses translucent winter melon with the back of a spoon.

dong-gua-cha.zh: 手用木勺轻压筛中的冬瓜，金色汁水流入碗中。
dong-gua-cha.en: A hand gently presses winter melon in a sieve as golden juice flows into a bowl.

dong-gua-cha.zh: 手往杯中的冬瓜茶浓缩汁里倒水。
dong-gua-cha.en: A hand pours water into a glass of winter melon tea concentrate.

dong-gua-niang-rou.zh: 双手弯起一片冬瓜薄片，检查厚度。
dong-gua-niang-rou.en: Hands bend a thin slice of winter melon to check its thickness.

dong-gua-niang-rou.zh: 双手弯起盐渍后变软的冬瓜片。
dong-gua-niang-rou.en: Hands bend a softened, salted slice of winter melon.

dong-gua-niang-rou.zh: 用筷子沿同一方向搅拌肉馅至黏稠。
dong-gua-niang-rou.en: Chopsticks stir the pork filling in one direction until sticky.

dong-gua-niang-rou.zh: 双手用冬瓜片围住肉馅，盘中摆着瓜卷和肉饼。
dong-gua-niang-rou.en: Hands wrap a winter melon slice around pork filling beside rolls and a patty on a plate.

dong-gua-niang-rou.zh: 揭开蒸锅盖，用探针检查瓜卷里的肉馅。
dong-gua-niang-rou.en: A probe checks the pork filling in steamed winter melon rolls.

dong-gua-niang-rou.zh: 将水淀粉倒入沸腾的汁水中，一边用勺推匀。
dong-gua-niang-rou.en: Starch slurry is poured into bubbling cooking juices while a spoon stirs.

dong-gua-niang-rou.zh: 用勺将薄芡淋在撒了葱绿的冬瓜酿肉上。
dong-gua-niang-rou.en: A spoon drizzles light sauce over stuffed winter melon topped with scallions.

dong-gua-sang-na-ji.zh: 用筷子拌匀裹着腌汁和姜丝的鸡块。
dong-gua-sang-na-ji.en: Mix chicken pieces with marinade and ginger using chopsticks.

dong-gua-sang-na-ji.zh: 从清水中捞起柔软弯曲的虫草花。
dong-gua-sang-na-ji.en: Lift softened, bending cordyceps flowers from water.

dong-gua-sang-na-ji.zh: 将冬瓜薄片摊放在有边沿的盘底。
dong-gua-sang-na-ji.en: Spread thin winter melon slices across a rimmed plate.

dong-gua-sang-na-ji.zh: 用筷子把腌鸡块铺在虫草花和冬瓜上。
dong-gua-sang-na-ji.en: Arrange marinated chicken over cordyceps flowers and winter melon with chopsticks.

dong-gua-sang-na-ji.zh: 盖好的蒸锅在火上持续冒出蒸汽。
dong-gua-sang-na-ji.en: Steam rises steadily from a covered steamer over the flame.

dong-gua-sang-na-ji.zh: 用温度计探入蒸熟的鸡块中心。
dong-gua-sang-na-ji.en: Insert a thermometer into the center of a cooked chicken piece.

dong-gua-sang-na-ji.zh: 用防烫夹提起盛着冬瓜桑拿鸡和汤汁的盘子。
dong-gua-sang-na-ji.en: Lift the plate of steamed chicken, winter melon and juices with a heatproof lifter.

dong-ning-cha.zh: 手按住壶盖，茶叶在浓红褐色茶汤中展开。
dong-ning-cha.en: A hand holds the lid of a teapot as tea leaves unfurl in deep reddish-brown tea.

dong-ning-cha.zh: 手在小火上搅拌清亮的糖浆。
dong-ning-cha.en: A hand stirs clear syrup in a saucepan over low heat.

dong-ning-cha.zh: 手触摸坐在凉水盆里的茶壶，旁边的糖浆放凉。
dong-ning-cha.en: A hand touches a teapot cooling in a basin of water beside a cup of syrup.

dong-ning-cha.zh: 手用长匙轻压两杯中一片柠檬的果肉，挤出汁液。
dong-ning-cha.en: A hand gently presses the flesh of a lemon slice in one of two glasses, releasing juice.

dong-ning-cha.zh: 手用长匙从杯底向上搅拌加了冰块和柠檬的茶。
dong-ning-cha.en: A hand stirs tea with ice and lemon upward from the bottom of a glass.

dong-ning-cha.zh: 手用长匙轻压冻柠茶中的柠檬果肉。
dong-ning-cha.en: A hand gently presses lemon flesh in a glass of iced lemon tea.

dong-po-rou.zh: 双手将焯过的带皮五花肉切成方块。
dong-po-rou.en: Hands cut blanched skin-on pork belly into squares.

dong-po-rou.zh: 手将酱汁倒入铺有葱姜和五花肉的锅中。
dong-po-rou.en: A hand pours sauce into a pot of pork belly, scallions, and ginger.

dong-po-rou.zh: 手掀起锅盖查看轻轻冒泡的五花肉。
dong-po-rou.en: A hand lifts the lid to check pork belly gently bubbling in sauce.

dong-po-rou.zh: 手用宽锅铲托起肉块翻面，让红褐色肉皮朝上。
dong-po-rou.en: A hand turns a pork belly block with a broad spatula, bringing its reddish-brown skin upward.

dong-po-rou.zh: 手将煨汁浇在深盘里的东坡肉上。
dong-po-rou.en: A hand spoons braising sauce over Dongpo pork in a deep dish.

dorayaki.zh: 双手用刮刀翻拌碗中均匀的浅黄色面糊。
dorayaki.en: Hands fold smooth pale yellow batter in a bowl with a spatula.

dorayaki.zh: 勺中的面糊连续流回碗里，旁边放着一小碗水。
dorayaki.en: Batter flows continuously from a spoon into a bowl beside a small bowl of water.

dorayaki.zh: 手用厨房纸擦拭小火上的不粘锅底。
dorayaki.en: A hand wipes the bottom of a nonstick pan over low heat with kitchen paper.

dorayaki.zh: 宽铲托起表面起泡、边缘凝住的小圆饼。
dorayaki.en: A wide spatula lifts a pancake with bubbles on its surface and set edges.

dorayaki.zh: 双手掰开煎好的饼皮，露出熟透的内部。
dorayaki.en: Hands break open a cooked pancake to reveal its cooked interior.

dorayaki.zh: 双手将两片饼皮轻合，夹住颗粒红豆馅。
dorayaki.en: Hands gently close two pancakes around chunky red bean filling.

dou-ban-yu.zh: 手将盐抹进生鱼的斜刀口。
dou-ban-yu.en: A hand rubs salt into the slits of the raw fish.

dou-ban-yu.zh: 用两把宽铲托起煎至浅金黄的整鱼。
dou-ban-yu.en: Two wide spatulas lift a whole fish with lightly golden skin.

dou-ban-yu.zh: 锅中炒散豆瓣、豆豉和姜蒜葱白，油色红亮。
dou-ban-yu.en: Douban, fermented black beans and aromatics are stirred in glossy red oil.

dou-ban-yu.zh: 锅中红汤冒泡，用铲子刮松锅底的煎鱼碎屑。
dou-ban-yu.en: Red broth bubbles as a spatula scrapes browned fish bits from the pan.

dou-ban-yu.zh: 用勺将锅中红汤浇在整鱼身上。
dou-ban-yu.en: A ladle spoons red broth over the whole fish in the pan.

dou-ban-yu.zh: 将红色豆瓣汁浇在盘中的整鱼上。
dou-ban-yu.en: Red bean sauce is poured over the whole fish on a platter.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 手持菜刀把油麦菜切段，菜梗和菜叶分开摆放。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: Hands cut Chinese lettuce into sections, with stalks and leaves separated.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 手从鲮鱼段中取出鱼刺，旁边放着豆豉、蒜和油。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: Hands remove a bone from a piece of dace beside bowls of black beans, garlic and oil.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 大火翻炒油麦菜，叶片刚变软，锅底渗出菜汁。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: Hands stir-fry lettuce over high heat until the leaves soften and juices collect in the wok.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 手把炒过的油麦菜倒入漏篮，菜汁沥入碗中。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: Hands pour stir-fried lettuce into a colander, draining the juices into a bowl.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 小火用锅铲翻开豆豉和蒜，豆粒散在油中。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: A spatula spreads black beans and garlic through oil over low heat.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 小火轻推鲮鱼块，鱼肉裹上豆豉蒜油。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: A spatula gently turns dace pieces in black bean and garlic oil over low heat.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 手向锅里的油麦菜、鲮鱼和豆豉撒入白糖。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: A hand sprinkles sugar over lettuce, dace and black beans in the wok.

dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.zh: 手将鲮鱼、豆豉和油麦菜从锅中盛入盘中。
dou-chi-ling-yu-you-mai-cai.en: Hands serve dace, black beans and lettuce from the wok onto a plate.

dou-fu-nao.zh: 手切泡软的香菇，旁边放着木耳丝、黄花菜和泡发水。
dou-fu-nao.en: Hands slice softened shiitake beside wood ear strips, daylily pieces, and soaking liquid.

dou-fu-nao.zh: 一边搅拌碗中豆浆悬液，一边倒入余下豆浆。
dou-fu-nao.en: Soy milk is poured into the bowl while the suspension is stirred.

dou-fu-nao.zh: 揭开蒸碗上的小盘，露出凝住的豆腐脑。
dou-fu-nao.en: A hand lifts the plate from the bowl of set tofu pudding in the steamer.

dou-fu-nao.zh: 锅中翻炒发白的肉丝、干货和葱白。
dou-fu-nao.en: A hand stir-fries pale pork strips, rehydrated ingredients, and scallion whites.

dou-fu-nao.zh: 将水淀粉细细淋入小火煮着的卤汁，同时轻推。
dou-fu-nao.en: Cornstarch slurry is poured into simmering gravy while it is gently stirred.

dou-fu-nao.zh: 将蛋花卤浇在豆腐脑上，旁边放着另一碗。
dou-fu-nao.en: Egg gravy is ladled over tofu pudding beside a second bowl.

dou-jiang.zh: 手掰开泡胀的黄豆，检查豆芯。
dou-jiang.en: A hand splits a plump soaked soybean to check its center.

dou-jiang.zh: 搅拌机将泡好的黄豆打成均匀乳白色浆液。
dou-jiang.en: A blender turns soaked soybeans into an even milky slurry.

dou-jiang.zh: 双手轻挤纱布袋，豆浆经过筛子流入碗中。
dou-jiang.en: Hands gently squeeze a cheesecloth bag, straining soy milk through a sieve into a bowl.

dou-jiang.zh: 中火加热豆浆，边搅拌边煮至浆液翻滚。
dou-jiang.en: Soy milk boils steadily over medium heat while a hand stirs it.

dou-jiang.zh: 小火煮豆浆，轻轻搅拌锅中微微冒泡的浆液。
dou-jiang.en: A hand stirs gently bubbling soy milk over low heat.

dou-jiang.zh: 用勺将煮好的豆浆盛入红边碗中。
dou-jiang.en: A hand ladles cooked soy milk into a red-rimmed bowl.

dou-jiao-men-mian.zh: 切豆角段，旁边备好葱姜蒜、肉片和鲜面。
dou-jiao-men-mian.en: Hands cut beans into lengths beside prepared scallions, ginger, garlic, pork and fresh noodles.

dou-jiao-men-mian.zh: 向炒至变色的五花肉和葱姜中淋入生抽。
dou-jiao-men-mian.en: A hand pours light soy sauce over cooked pork belly, scallions and ginger.

dou-jiao-men-mian.zh: 向沸腾的豆角肉片汤中倒入热水。
dou-jiao-men-mian.en: A hand pours hot water into bubbling broth with beans and pork belly.

dou-jiao-men-mian.zh: 用筷子将鲜面松散铺在豆角肉片上。
dou-jiao-men-mian.en: Chopsticks spread loose fresh noodles over cooked beans and pork belly.

dou-jiao-men-mian.zh: 用勺将留出的菜汤淋在锅里的面条上。
dou-jiao-men-mian.en: A ladle pours reserved broth over noodles in the wok.

dou-jiao-men-mian.zh: 用筷子挑拌面条、豆角、肉片和蒜末。
dou-jiao-men-mian.en: Chopsticks gently mix noodles, beans, pork belly and minced garlic.

dou-jiao-men-mian.zh: 用筷子将豆角肉片焖面夹入盘中。
dou-jiao-men-mian.en: Chopsticks transfer noodles with beans and pork belly onto a plate.

dubu-jorim.zh: 手用厨房纸轻按平铺的豆腐片，吸干表面水分。
dubu-jorim.en: A hand gently pats tofu slices dry with kitchen paper.

dubu-jorim.zh: 手用勺搅拌带葱花、蒜末、芝麻和辣椒的烧汁。
dubu-jorim.en: A hand stirs sauce with scallions, minced garlic, sesame, and chili.

dubu-jorim.zh: 手将豆腐片单层放入有薄油的平底锅中。
dubu-jorim.en: A hand places tofu slices in a single layer in an oiled skillet.

dubu-jorim.zh: 手用锅铲翻起豆腐片，露出浅金黄色的煎面。
dubu-jorim.en: A hand turns a tofu slice with a spatula, revealing its light golden underside.

dubu-jorim.zh: 手将烧汁淋在豆腐上，锅底酱汁冒着小泡。
dubu-jorim.en: A hand pours sauce over tofu as small bubbles rise in the pan.

dubu-jorim.zh: 手用锅铲将裹着烧汁的豆腐盛到盘中。
dubu-jorim.en: A hand transfers glazed tofu from the pan to a plate with a spatula.

dubu-kimchi.zh: 用勺拌匀猪肉、泡菜和洋葱，肉片裹满红色调味料。
dubu-kimchi.en: Mix pork, kimchi and onion with a spoon until the pork is coated in red seasoning.

dubu-kimchi.zh: 用宽铲将豆腐块托入微微冒泡的水中。
dubu-kimchi.en: Lower a block of tofu into gently bubbling water with a broad spatula.

dubu-kimchi.zh: 将沥过水的豆腐切成厚片，旁边盘里已摆好几片。
dubu-kimchi.en: Slice the drained tofu into thick pieces, with several slices already on a plate.

dubu-kimchi.zh: 将腌好的猪肉和泡菜混合物倒入热平底锅。
dubu-kimchi.en: Pour the marinated pork and kimchi mixture into a hot frying pan.

dubu-kimchi.zh: 用锅铲翻炒猪肉和泡菜，浓汁裹住食材。
dubu-kimchi.en: Stir-fry pork and kimchi with a spatula until coated in thick sauce.

dubu-kimchi.zh: 在豆腐旁的泡菜炒猪肉上撒白芝麻。
dubu-kimchi.en: Sprinkle white sesame seeds over the stir-fried pork and kimchi beside the tofu.

duo-jiao-yu-tou.zh: 在摊平的生鱼头厚肉处划刀。
duo-jiao-yu-tou.en: Score the thick flesh of the flattened raw fish head.

duo-jiao-yu-tou.zh: 将生鱼头肉面向上放在姜丝上，旁边备好配料。
duo-jiao-yu-tou.en: Place the raw fish head flesh side up on ginger strips, with the aromatics prepared alongside.

duo-jiao-yu-tou.zh: 小火上翻炒剁椒、豆豉和葱姜蒜，蒜仍呈浅色。
duo-jiao-yu-tou.en: Stir chopped chilies, fermented black beans and aromatics over a low flame, keeping the garlic pale.

duo-jiao-yu-tou.zh: 用勺将剁椒豆豉连油铺在鱼头上。
duo-jiao-yu-tou.en: Spoon the chili and black bean mixture with its oil over the fish head.

duo-jiao-yu-tou.zh: 揭开蒸锅盖，用筷子检查鱼头脸颊的熟度。
duo-jiao-yu-tou.en: Lift the steamer lid and check the fish cheek with chopsticks.

duo-jiao-yu-tou.zh: 将热油淋在铺有葱绿和剁椒的鱼头上。
duo-jiao-yu-tou.en: Pour hot oil over the scallions and chilies on the fish head.

egg-fried-rice.zh: 双手在碗上轻轻掰散饭团，米粒落入碗中。
egg-fried-rice.en: Hands gently break apart clumps of rice over a bowl.

egg-fried-rice.zh: 手在碗中打匀鸡蛋，旁边备有葱花、生抽和油。
egg-fried-rice.en: A hand whisks eggs in a bowl beside chopped scallions, soy sauce and oil.

egg-fried-rice.zh: 锅铲将炒锅中膨起的软蛋块折起，推向一边。
egg-fried-rice.en: A spatula folds the puffed, soft egg to one side of the wok.

egg-fried-rice.zh: 锅铲从底部翻起米饭和蛋块，米粒散开。
egg-fried-rice.en: A spatula lifts rice and egg from the bottom of the wok, separating the grains.

egg-fried-rice.zh: 锅铲翻起粒粒分开的蛋炒饭，锅中冒着热汽。
egg-fried-rice.en: A spatula lifts separate grains of rice and egg as steam rises from the wok.

egg-fried-rice.zh: 手持锅铲将葱花蛋炒饭从锅中盛到盘里。
egg-fried-rice.en: A hand uses a spatula to serve egg fried rice with scallions onto a plate.

eomuk-bokkeum.zh: 手正搅拌酱汁，旁边摆着切好的洋葱和红绿甜椒。
eomuk-bokkeum.en: A hand stirs the sauce beside sliced onion and red and green bell peppers.

eomuk-bokkeum.zh: 手用漏勺从热水中捞起柔软弯曲的鱼饼。
eomuk-bokkeum.en: A hand lifts a soft, bending fish cake sheet from hot water with a slotted spoon.

eomuk-bokkeum.zh: 手将沥干的鱼饼切片，旁边备好葱段和蒜末。
eomuk-bokkeum.en: Hands cut drained fish cake into pieces beside prepared scallion and minced garlic.

eomuk-bokkeum.zh: 手在锅中翻炒蒜末、葱和边缘渐透的洋葱。
eomuk-bokkeum.en: A hand stir-fries garlic, scallion and onion with translucent edges in a pan.

eomuk-bokkeum.zh: 手用铲子从锅底翻起鱼饼和红绿甜椒。
eomuk-bokkeum.en: A hand lifts fish cake and red and green bell peppers from the bottom of the pan with a spatula.

eomuk-bokkeum.zh: 手翻炒裹上浅褐色酱汁的鱼饼和蔬菜。
eomuk-bokkeum.en: A hand stir-fries fish cake and vegetables coated in a light brown sauce.

fagioli-alluccelletto.zh: 把清水倒入装有泡发白豆的锅中。
fagioli-alluccelletto.en: Pour fresh water into a pot of soaked white beans.

fagioli-alluccelletto.zh: 白豆在大火上持续翻滚沸煮。
fagioli-alluccelletto.en: White beans boil vigorously over high heat.

fagioli-alluccelletto.zh: 小火加热橄榄油、蒜和鼠尾草，舀出淡金黄的蒜。
fagioli-alluccelletto.en: Lift pale golden garlic from olive oil and sage over low heat.

fagioli-alluccelletto.zh: 往番茄白豆中倒入煮豆水，用勺轻翻。
fagioli-alluccelletto.en: Pour bean cooking water into the tomatoes and white beans while gently folding them.

fagioli-alluccelletto.zh: 将浓稠的番茄白豆舀入浅碗。
fagioli-alluccelletto.en: Ladle thick tomato and white beans into a shallow bowl.

fagiolini-al-pomodoro.zh: 用漏勺从沸水中捞出四季豆沥水。
fagiolini-al-pomodoro.en: A slotted spoon lifts green beans from boiling water to drain.

fagiolini-al-pomodoro.zh: 蒜末在平底锅的橄榄油中冒出小泡。
fagiolini-al-pomodoro.en: Minced garlic bubbles gently in olive oil in a skillet.

fagiolini-al-pomodoro.zh: 把压碎的番茄倒入有蒜末和辣椒碎的平底锅。
fagiolini-al-pomodoro.en: Crushed tomatoes are poured into a skillet with garlic and chili flakes.

fagiolini-al-pomodoro.zh: 用勺翻拌四季豆，让浓番茄汁裹住豆子。
fagiolini-al-pomodoro.en: A spoon stirs green beans until they are coated in thick tomato sauce.

fagiolini-al-pomodoro.zh: 盘中盛着裹有番茄汁和蒜粒的四季豆。
fagiolini-al-pomodoro.en: Green beans coated in tomato sauce and garlic are served on a plate.

fan-qie-fei-niu.zh: 手在案板上切番茄丁，旁边放着姜蒜末和金针菇。
fan-qie-fei-niu.en: Hands dice tomatoes beside minced ginger, garlic and enoki mushrooms.

fan-qie-fei-niu.zh: 手用锅铲翻炒油中颜色浅淡的姜蒜末。
fan-qie-fei-niu.en: A hand stirs pale minced ginger and garlic in oil.

fan-qie-fei-niu.zh: 手用锅铲轻压炒软出汁的番茄块。
fan-qie-fei-niu.en: A hand presses softened tomatoes releasing red juices with a spatula.

fan-qie-fei-niu.zh: 手搅动沸腾的均匀番茄汤。
fan-qie-fei-niu.en: A hand stirs the evenly colored boiling tomato broth.

fan-qie-fei-niu.zh: 手用筷子拨散番茄汤中已经变色的肥牛片。
fan-qie-fei-niu.en: A hand separates cooked beef slices in tomato broth with chopsticks.

fan-qie-fei-niu.zh: 手把番茄肥牛和金针菇汤舀进深碗。
fan-qie-fei-niu.en: A hand ladles tomato beef and enoki soup into a deep bowl.

fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.zh: 手正将牛肉切成薄片，旁边摆着备好的配料和蛋液。
fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.en: Hands slice beef thinly beside prepared ingredients and beaten egg.

fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.zh: 手将盐和胡椒拌入碗中的牛肉薄片。
fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.en: A hand mixes salt and pepper into thin slices of beef in a bowl.

fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.zh: 勺背轻压锅中煮软的番茄，汤里留有完整番茄块。
fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.en: A spoon presses softened tomatoes while some pieces remain intact in the broth.

fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.zh: 手将牛肉薄片分散放入微沸的番茄汤中。
fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.en: A hand adds thin beef slices to gently simmering tomato broth.

fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.zh: 手将蛋液细流淋入番茄牛肉汤，锅中已有柔软蛋花。
fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.en: A hand pours a thin stream of beaten egg into tomato beef soup with soft egg ribbons.

fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.zh: 手用汤勺将番茄牛肉蛋花汤盛入碗中。
fan-qie-niu-rou-dan-hua-tang.en: A hand ladles tomato, beef and egg drop soup into a bowl.

fan-sha-yu-tou.zh: 手用布擦干案板上的芋条，旁边放着葱花。
fan-sha-yu-tou.en: A hand dries taro batons on a cutting board beside chopped scallions.

fan-sha-yu-tou.zh: 筷子把一条芋头放入油锅试炸，周围冒出气泡。
fan-sha-yu-tou.en: Chopsticks lower one taro baton into hot oil, where bubbles form around it.

fan-sha-yu-tou.zh: 夹子夹起略黄的芋条，筷子扎入中心检查熟度。
fan-sha-yu-tou.en: Tongs hold a lightly golden taro baton while a chopstick tests its center.

fan-sha-yu-tou.zh: 小火下用铲子推动透明糖液，锅中布满细密气泡。
fan-sha-yu-tou.en: A spatula pushes clear syrup covered with fine bubbles over low heat.

fan-sha-yu-tou.zh: 离火后用铲子翻起芋条和葱花，裹上透明糖液。
fan-sha-yu-tou.en: Off the heat, a spatula folds taro and scallions through clear syrup.

fan-sha-yu-tou.zh: 筷子将裹着白色细砂的芋条分开放在盘中。
fan-sha-yu-tou.en: Chopsticks arrange the taro batons separately on a plate, coated in fine white sugar crystals.

fen-zheng-rou.zh: 手切带皮五花肉，案板上放着姜末和蒜末。
fen-zheng-rou.en: Hands slice skin-on pork belly beside minced ginger and garlic.

fen-zheng-rou.zh: 用筷子拌匀五花肉和腌料。
fen-zheng-rou.en: Chopsticks mix pork belly with the marinade.

fen-zheng-rou.zh: 用筷子翻拌裹满湿润米粉的肉片。
fen-zheng-rou.en: Chopsticks fold pork slices coated in moist rice powder.

fen-zheng-rou.zh: 将裹粉肉片松放在碗底的土豆片上。
fen-zheng-rou.en: A hand loosely arranges rice-coated pork over potato slices.

fen-zheng-rou.zh: 盖上蒸锅，锅底火焰加热，锅盖边冒出蒸汽。
fen-zheng-rou.en: A hand covers the steamer as flames heat it and steam escapes.

fen-zheng-rou.zh: 用筷子戳碗中央的粉蒸肉，检查是否软透。
fen-zheng-rou.en: Chopsticks test the central piece of steamed pork for tenderness.

fettuccine-al-burro.zh: 双手将奶酪擦成细末，旁边备好黄油小块和大碗。
fettuccine-al-burro.en: Hands finely grate cheese beside cubed butter and a large bowl.

fettuccine-al-burro.zh: 手用木勺拨开沸水中的鸡蛋宽面。
fettuccine-al-burro.en: A hand separates egg fettuccine in boiling water with a wooden spoon.

fettuccine-al-burro.zh: 双手在大碗中翻拌沾着奶酪的宽面，旁边放着煮面水。
fettuccine-al-burro.en: Hands toss cheese-coated fettuccine in a large bowl beside reserved pasta water.

fettuccine-al-burro.zh: 双手翻拌宽面，面上的黄油小块逐渐融化。
fettuccine-al-burro.en: Hands toss fettuccine as small pieces of butter melt on the pasta.

fettuccine-al-burro.zh: 双手将宽面分到盘中，旁边放着一碗奶酪末。
fettuccine-al-burro.en: Hands serve fettuccine onto a plate beside a bowl of grated cheese.

flammekueche.zh: 双手揉光滑面团，旁边备着面粉、盐、水和油。
flammekueche.en: Hands knead smooth dough beside bowls of flour, salt, water and oil.

flammekueche.zh: 双手打开烤箱门，厚烤盘放在中下层预热。
flammekueche.en: Hands open the oven door to reveal a thick tray preheating on a lower-middle rack.

flammekueche.zh: 锅中培根细条出油，旁边放着拆散的洋葱薄片。
flammekueche.en: Bacon strips render in a pan beside a bowl of separated onion slices.

flammekueche.zh: 双手将面团擀成薄长方形，旁边备着调味奶油。
flammekueche.en: Hands roll dough into a thin rectangle beside a bowl of seasoned cream.

flammekueche.zh: 手将洋葱和培根分散撒在抹了奶油的生面片上。
flammekueche.en: A hand scatters onion and bacon over a cream-coated sheet of raw dough.

flammekueche.zh: 铲子抬起薄饼一角，露出金黄色的饼底。
flammekueche.en: A spatula lifts a corner of the tart to reveal its golden underside.

flammekueche.zh: 双手在架上把金黄的洋葱培根薄饼切成六块。
flammekueche.en: Hands cut the golden onion and bacon tart into six pieces on a rack.

focaccia-genovese.zh: 用勺拌匀碗中的面团，直到看不见干粉。
focaccia-genovese.en: A spoon mixes the dough in a bowl until no dry flour remains.

focaccia-genovese.zh: 双手将柔软面团拉成不断裂的薄片。
focaccia-genovese.en: Two hands stretch the soft dough into an unbroken thin sheet.

focaccia-genovese.zh: 手指轻按烤盘中膨大的面团，湿布放在一旁。
focaccia-genovese.en: A finger presses the risen dough in the pan, with a damp cloth beside it.

focaccia-genovese.zh: 双手将面团推向烤盘四角，铺成薄层。
focaccia-genovese.en: Two hands push the dough toward the corners of the pan in a thin layer.

focaccia-genovese.zh: 将油盐水浇在布满凹窝的面团上。
focaccia-genovese.en: Oil and salt water are poured over the dimpled dough.

focaccia-genovese.zh: 在网架上将金黄的佛卡夏切成长块。
focaccia-genovese.en: Golden focaccia is cut into long pieces on a wire rack.

french-omelette.zh: 用叉子搅打碗里均匀的蛋液，旁边放着盘子和软铲。
french-omelette.en: A fork beats the evenly mixed eggs in a bowl beside a plate and silicone spatula.

french-omelette.zh: 转动平底锅，让浅色起泡的黄油铺满锅底。
french-omelette.en: The pan is tilted to coat its bottom with pale, foaming butter.

french-omelette.zh: 用软铲在锅中画圈，搅动细小湿润的蛋凝块。
french-omelette.en: A silicone spatula stirs small, moist egg curds in the pan.

french-omelette.zh: 小火上用软铲铺平蛋液，锅底形成薄薄的一层。
french-omelette.en: A silicone spatula spreads the eggs into a thin layer over low heat.

french-omelette.zh: 离火后用软铲将蛋皮的一边向中间折起。
french-omelette.en: Off the heat, a silicone spatula folds one edge of the egg sheet toward the center.

french-omelette.zh: 锅倾在盘上，浅黄色蛋卷已扣入盘中。
french-omelette.en: The pan is tipped above the plate after the pale yellow omelette has been turned out.

french-onion-soup.zh: 揭开锅盖，锅中洋葱丝已变软、半透明。
french-onion-soup.en: A lid is lifted to reveal softened, translucent sliced onions.

french-onion-soup.zh: 翻炒深褐色洋葱丝，同时撒入少许盐。
french-onion-soup.en: Deep brown sliced onions are stirred as a little salt is added.

french-onion-soup.zh: 小火翻炒褐色洋葱，面粉已裹入洋葱。
french-onion-soup.en: Browned onions are stirred over low heat after the flour has been incorporated.

french-onion-soup.zh: 离火倒入高汤，用木勺刮起锅底褐色薄膜。
french-onion-soup.en: Stock is poured into the pot off the heat as a spoon scrapes up browned bits.

french-onion-soup.zh: 半盖锅盖慢煮洋葱汤，撒入黑胡椒。
french-onion-soup.en: Black pepper is added to gently simmering onion soup beneath a partially covered lid.

french-onion-soup.zh: 用夹子夹起烤至微黄的厚法棍片。
french-onion-soup.en: Tongs lift a thick baguette slice toasted lightly golden.

french-onion-soup.zh: 用布端起热汤碗，面包上的奶酪已焗至金黄。
french-onion-soup.en: A hot bowl of onion soup is carried with a cloth, topped with bread and golden melted cheese.

fresh-egg-pasta.zh: 用叉子将面粉从内圈拌入蛋液，面粉墙保持完整。
fresh-egg-pasta.en: A fork draws flour from the inner wall into beaten eggs while the flour wall remains intact.

fresh-egg-pasta.zh: 双手用掌根推压并折叠光滑的面团。
fresh-egg-pasta.en: Hands press and fold smooth dough with the heel of the palm.

fresh-egg-pasta.zh: 手轻压包在保鲜膜中的面团。
fresh-egg-pasta.en: A hand gently presses dough wrapped in cling film.

fresh-egg-pasta.zh: 双手用擀面杖擀薄面片，旁边的面团盖着碗。
fresh-egg-pasta.en: Hands roll a thin pasta sheet beside another portion covered by a bowl.

fresh-egg-pasta.zh: 双手用刀将折叠的面片切成宽条，切好的面条松散摆开。
fresh-egg-pasta.en: Hands cut a folded pasta sheet into wide ribbons, with cut noodles lying loosely nearby.

fresh-egg-pasta.zh: 用木勺拨散沸水中的宽面，锅旁放着盐。
fresh-egg-pasta.en: A wooden spoon separates wide noodles in boiling water, with a bowl of salt beside the pot.

frittata.zh: 备好金属柄平底锅、细擦奶酪和盘子，烤箱上火预热。
frittata.en: An oven-safe skillet, grated cheese and plate sit ready beside the preheated broiler.

frittata.zh: 用叉子拌匀蛋液、奶酪和黑胡椒。
frittata.en: A hand mixes eggs, grated cheese and black pepper with a fork.

frittata.zh: 将蛋液倒入黄油起细泡的平底锅。
frittata.en: A hand pours the egg mixture into a skillet of gently foaming butter.

frittata.zh: 用铲子轻托已定形的蛋饼边缘，表面仍湿润。
frittata.en: A spatula lifts the set edge of the frittata while its surface remains moist.

frittata.zh: 烘蛋在烤箱上火下凝固，用探针测量中心。
frittata.en: A probe checks the center of the set frittata beneath the broiler.

frittata.zh: 用刀将盘中的金黄烘蛋切成四块。
frittata.en: A hand cuts the golden frittata into four wedges on a plate.

hollandaise.zh: 液态澄清黄油旁放着搅拌碗、打蛋器和凉水。
hollandaise.en: Liquid clarified butter sits beside a mixing bowl, whisk, and cool water.

hollandaise.zh: 小火加热水浴，搅拌碗底悬在微冒泡的水面上方。
hollandaise.en: A mixing bowl rests above gently bubbling water over a low flame.

hollandaise.zh: 提起打蛋器，浅黄色蛋黄液落下并留下带状痕迹。
hollandaise.en: A lifted whisk leaves a ribbon of pale yolk mixture on the surface.

hollandaise.zh: 一边滴入澄清黄油，一边搅打光滑的蛋黄液。
hollandaise.en: A hand whisks the smooth yolk mixture as clarified butter is added drop by drop.

hollandaise.zh: 一边细流倒入澄清黄油，一边搅打浓滑的酱。
hollandaise.en: A hand whisks the smooth thick sauce as clarified butter is poured in a thin stream.

hollandaise.zh: 用勺将荷兰酱淋在芦笋上，旁边放着酱船和柠檬。
hollandaise.en: A hand spoons hollandaise over asparagus beside a gravy boat and lemon.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 整条五花肉在沸水中焯至外层发白，水面浮出泡沫。
hong-shao-rou.en: A whole strip of pork belly blanches in boiling water, its exterior pale and foam rising to the surface.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 用刀将焯过的带皮五花肉切成大小相近的肉块。
hong-shao-rou.en: Hands cut blanched skin-on pork belly into evenly sized cubes.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 小火下用铲子轻推锅中红褐色的糖液。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand gently stirs reddish-brown caramel over low heat.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 五花肉块裹上糖色，手沿锅边倒入绍兴酒。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand pours Shaoxing wine along the edge of the pot of caramel-coated pork belly.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 五花肉与姜、八角、辣椒、桂皮和葱在锅中小火微沸。
hong-shao-rou.en: Pork belly simmers gently with ginger, star anise, chilies, cinnamon and scallions.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 用筷子插入锅中较厚的五花肉块，检查软度。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand inserts chopsticks into a thick piece of pork belly to check its tenderness.

hong-shao-rou.zh: 大火翻动五花肉，亮汁裹住肉块，锅底留有少量汁。
hong-shao-rou.en: A hand turns pork belly over high heat as glossy sauce coats the pieces and a little remains in the pot.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手抓拌碗中上浆的鸡丁，鸡肉均匀裹浆。
kung-pao-chicken.en: A hand mixes evenly coated chicken cubes in a bowl.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手剪干辣椒段，案板上摆着葱白、姜蒜片和花生。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands snip dried chilies beside scallion whites, ginger, garlic and a bowl of peanuts.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手用勺搅匀碗中的深色料汁。
kung-pao-chicken.en: A hand stirs the dark sauce in a bowl.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手在锅中翻炒干辣椒段和花椒。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands stir-fry dried chili segments and Sichuan peppercorns in a wok.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手翻炒鸡丁与香料，铲上鸡丁的切面已熟透。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands stir-fry chicken and aromatics, showing a cooked chicken cube cut open on the spatula.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手翻炒鸡丁与香料，沸腾的亮芡裹住鸡丁。
kung-pao-chicken.en: Hands toss chicken and aromatics in a bubbling, glossy sauce.

kung-pao-chicken.zh: 手将花生倒入锅中，鸡丁已裹上亮芡。
kung-pao-chicken.en: A hand pours peanuts into a wok of glossy sauce-coated chicken and aromatics.

mapo-tofu.zh: 豆腐块在淡盐水中微微沸煮。
mapo-tofu.en: Tofu cubes simmer gently in lightly salted water.

mapo-tofu.zh: 用勺搅匀碗里的土豆淀粉和冷水。
mapo-tofu.en: A spoon mixes potato starch and cold water in a bowl.

mapo-tofu.zh: 牛肉末煸至褐色出油，料酒沿锅边淋入。
mapo-tofu.en: Cooking wine is poured around the wok's edge over browned, lightly oily ground beef.

mapo-tofu.zh: 豆瓣与肉末炒出红油，加入豆豉和香料。
mapo-tofu.en: Black beans and aromatics are added to beef and chili bean paste in red oil.

mapo-tofu.zh: 用锅铲背面轻推汤汁里的豆腐块。
mapo-tofu.en: The back of a spatula gently pushes tofu cubes through the sauce.

mapo-tofu.zh: 向豆腐和蒜苗的沸腾汤汁中分次淋入水淀粉。
mapo-tofu.en: A portion of starch slurry is poured into simmering tofu and green garlic.

mapo-tofu.zh: 在装盘的麻婆豆腐上撒花椒面。
mapo-tofu.en: Ground Sichuan pepper is sprinkled over the plated mapo tofu.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺翻炒五花肉末，锅底释出金黄油脂。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon stirs minced pork belly in a pool of rendered fat and olive oil.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 小火翻炒五花肉末和切细的洋葱、胡萝卜、西芹。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon stirs pork with finely diced onion, carrot and celery over low heat.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺翻炒牛肉和蔬菜，肉粒已变褐色。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon stirs browned ground beef and vegetables in the pot.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 往炒褐的肉末和蔬菜中倒入白葡萄酒。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: White wine is poured into the browned meat and vegetables.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 往番茄肉酱里倒入高汤，锅盖放在旁边。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: Stock is poured into the tomato and meat mixture, with the lid nearby.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 往小火炖煮的肉酱里倒入牛奶。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: Milk is poured into the meat sauce simmering over low heat.

ragu-alla-bolognese.zh: 用木勺将浓稠肉酱和煮熟的宽面拌在一起。
ragu-alla-bolognese.en: A wooden spoon tosses cooked broad pasta ribbons with thick meat sauce.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 用木勺翻炒油脂中软透微黄的洋葱末。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Stir softened, lightly golden minced onion in melted fat.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 用木勺翻炒裹油发亮的米粒和洋葱末。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Stir glossy, fat-coated rice grains with minced onion.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 往米和洋葱中倒入白葡萄酒并轻轻翻动。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Pour white wine into the rice and onion while stirring gently.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 用木勺轻推高汤中微沸的米粒，旁边备着热汤。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Gently push simmering rice through stock with a wooden spoon, with hot stock ready nearby.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 将浸泡藏红花的金色汤汁倒入微沸的米饭。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Pour golden saffron-infused stock into the simmering rice.

risotto-alla-milanese.zh: 离火将黄油和奶酪拌入金黄色烩饭。
risotto-alla-milanese.en: Stir butter and cheese into golden risotto off the heat.

steamed-fish.zh: 手用勺子在小碗里搅匀深色豉油汁。
steamed-fish.en: A hand stirs dark soy sauce mixture in a small bowl.

steamed-fish.zh: 手在架于三片姜上的整鱼厚处斜划刀口。
steamed-fish.en: A hand scores the thickest part of a whole fish resting on three ginger slices.

steamed-fish.zh: 双手将鱼盘放入蒸汽腾腾的大火蒸锅。
steamed-fish.en: Two hands lower the fish plate into a vigorously steaming pot over high heat.

steamed-fish.zh: 筷子拨开鱼背刀口，露出贴骨的白色鱼肉。
steamed-fish.en: Chopsticks open a cut in the fish, exposing white flesh at the bone.

steamed-fish.zh: 手将姜丝、葱绿丝和香菜铺在蒸鱼上。
steamed-fish.en: A hand places ginger, scallion greens and cilantro on the steamed fish.

steamed-fish.zh: 手向冒泡的姜丝豉油汁中放入葱白丝。
steamed-fish.en: A hand adds scallion whites to bubbling soy sauce and ginger.

steamed-fish.zh: 手将热油和豉油汁浇在铺有姜葱香菜的鱼上。
steamed-fish.en: A hand pours hot oil and soy sauce over fish topped with ginger, scallions and cilantro.

tomato-egg.zh: 手将番茄瓣和汁从案板拨入碗中，旁边放着葱花。
tomato-egg.en: A hand transfers tomato wedges and juice from a cutting board into a bowl beside chopped scallions.

tomato-egg.zh: 手用打蛋器搅匀蛋液，碗边放着调味料。
tomato-egg.en: A hand whisks the eggs until uniform, with seasonings beside the bowl.

tomato-egg.zh: 锅铲将刚凝固的鸡蛋推成湿润的大块。
tomato-egg.en: A spatula pushes the just-set eggs into large, moist curds in the wok.

tomato-egg.zh: 锅铲翻炒番茄瓣和葱花，锅底已有红色汁液。
tomato-egg.en: A spatula stirs tomato wedges and scallions in a wok with red juices at the bottom.

tomato-egg.zh: 锅铲轻压软番茄，浓汁沾在铲面上。
tomato-egg.en: A spatula presses softened tomatoes as thick sauce coats its surface.

tomato-egg.zh: 手用锅铲将番茄炒蛋盛入盘中。
tomato-egg.en: A hand uses a spatula to serve tomato and egg onto a plate.
